templateText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verseText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

templateText: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
verseText: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

templateText: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verseText: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

templateText: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
verseText: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

templateText: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
verseText: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

templateText: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
verseText: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

templateText: {name}, neno la Kigiriki kwa kanisa ni ekklesia — 'wale walioitwa.' Haukuchaguliwa kwa bahati; ulialikwa kwa makusudi. Kila njia panda katika hadithi yako ilikuwa ni kuelekea kusudi. Mungu anakuita kutoka wapi leo, na anakuita kuingia wapi?

{name}, katika Warumi 8:26 Paulo anasema Roho anashughulikia kwa 'kuugua kwa kina sana.' Kigiriki ni stenagmois alaletois — kuugua kutokuweza kueleweka. Wakati huwezi kupata maneno ya kuomba, Roho anatafsiri kimya chako kuwa maombi kamili. Wewe si kamwe kimya mbele ya Mungu.

{name}, Waebrania 12:2 inamwita Yesu 'mwandishi na mkamilishaji' wa imani. Kigiriki archegos kinamaanisha mpiga mbio — yule anayeenda kwanza na kuanzisha njia. Yesu hakukupa ramani kutoka mbali; alitembea barabara mbele yako. Fuata nyayo Zake kupitia shaka.

{name}, Yakobo 1:2-4 inatumia neno dokimion kwa 'kujaribu' imani — neno lile lile linalotumika kwa kupima dhahabu katika moto. Majaribu yako si adhabu; ni usafishaji. Joto halikuharibu; linafunua dhahabu ambayo ilikuwepo kila wakati.

{name}, katika Waefeso 1:4 Paulo anasema Mungu alikuchagua 'kabla ya msingi wa ulimwengu.' Kabla ya wakati, kabla ya uumbaji, kabla ya kitu chochote kuwepo, ulikuwa katika mawazo ya Mungu. Je, kuchaguliwa kwako kabla ya wakati kunaathiri vipi jinsi unavyoona mapambano yako ya sasa?

{name}, Isaya 53:5 inasema 'kwa majeraha yake tumeponywa.' Neno la Kiebrania kwa majeraha, chaburah, linaashiria alama za kupigwa. Yesu alichukua alama za kimwili ili uweze kubeba ukamilifu wa kiroho. Unahitaji kutekeleza wapi uponyaji ulio kamilika wa msalaba leo?

{name}, dhana ya 'tayari lakini bado si' inashughulika katika Agano Jipya. Ufalme umefika katika Kristo, lakini ukamilifu wake unangojea. Unaishi katika mvutano kati ya ahadi na kutimia. Je, kushikilia ukweli hizi mbili kunaathiri vipi uvumilivu wako na maombi yasiyo na majibu?

Baba, {name} amepita miongo mingi na Wewe na uaminifu umejijenga juu. Asante kwa miaka ya utoaji. Mpe {name} kusudi jipya katika sura hii na furaha ya kujua matunda bora mara nyingi hukua kwenye matawi ya zamani.

Bwana, mwili wa {name} si kama ulivyokuwa awali. Viungo vinakata na nguvu zinapungua mapema. Lakini roho ya {name} inRenewed kila siku. Imarisha kile kilicho dhaifu na umkumbusha {name} kwamba kuoza kwa nje hakiwezi kugusa uhai wa ndani.

Mungu, {name} ana hekima iliyopatikana kwa maisha yote. Monyeshe {name} anahitaji hiyo. Fungua milango ya kufundisha, kuhamasisha, na kuwekeza katika kizazi kijacho. Hadithi ya {name} haijaisha; inaingia katika sura yake yenye matunda zaidi.

Baba, nyumba sasa ni tulivu na simu zinapiga kidogo. Upweke unajitokeza mahali ambapo shughuli zilikuwa. Jaza upweke wa {name} na ushirika Wako. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba vyumba tulivu vinaweza kuwa ardhi ya takatifu.
Bwana, {name} amepoteza marafiki na wanafamilia katika safari hii. Maombolezo yanajikusanya na miaka. Mshike {name} karibu na usiseme tumaini la kuungana. Kifo si neno la mwisho; ufufuo ndio huo.
Yesu, {name} anasali kwa wajukuu kwa majina. Wafunike kwa ulinzi Wako na uwaongoze Kwako. Acha imani ambayo {name} ameijenga kwa miongo kuwa urithi wa kiroho unaopitishwa kwa vizazi.

Mungu, miadi ya madaktari imekuwa rhythm ya kawaida. Mpe {name} amani katika vyumba vya kusubiri na ujasiri katika mazungumzo na madaktari. Wewe ndiye Mponyaji wa mwisho, na {name} anakutumainia kwa kila matokeo.
Baba, {name} amekuwa mwaminifu kwa miongo na mstari wa kumaliza unakaribia. Mpe {name} uvumilivu wa kukimbia duru za mwisho kwa kujitolea sawa na ilivyokuwa mwanzo. Acha {name} amalize kwa nguvu.
Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
verseText: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

templateText: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts. They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verseText: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts. They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

templateText: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
verseText: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

templateText: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
verseText: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

templateText: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
verseText: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

templateText: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
verseText: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

templateText: {name}, Kalebu alikuwa na miaka 85 aliposema 'Nipe mlima huu.' Hakuomba kiti cha kutembea; aliiomba changamoto. Umri haukupunguza ujasiri wake. Ni mlima gani Mungu anakuweka mbele yako katika msimu huu ambao miguu michanga huenda haiko tayari kupanda?

{name}, Simeoni alisubiri maisha yake yote kumuona Masihi. Aliposhika mtoto Yesu, alisema, 'Macho yangu yameona wokovu Wako.' Ahadi zingine zinachukua maisha yote kufichuka. Uaminifu wako wa subira haujapotea. Unasubiri nini bado kuona?

{name}, katika Tito 2 Paulo anawaelekeza waamini wakubwa kufundisha vijana. Alama zako ni mtaala. Ushuhuda wako ni kitabu cha masomo. Hekima iliyopatikana kwa shida katika mifupa yako ndiyo hasa anachohitaji mtu mdogo. Nani anahitaji hadithi yako wiki hii?

{name}, Zaburi 71:18 inasema 'Hata nitakapokuwa mzee na mwenye kijivu, usinipuuze, Mungu wangu, mpaka nitakaposema nguvu zako kwa kizazi kijacho.' Ni hadithi gani ya uaminifu wa Mungu katika maisha yako ambayo kizazi kijacho hakijaisikia bado? Nani anahitaji kuisikia?

{name}, Musa alitumia miaka 40 katika ikulu, miaka 40 katika jangwa, na miaka 40 akiongoza Israeli. Kazi yake kubwa ilianza akiwa na miaka 80. Je, ni nini kama msimu ulionao sasa si hitimisho bali mwanzo wa sura yako muhimu zaidi?

{name}, katika 2 Timotheo 1:5 Paulo anampa Timotheo imani yake kwa bibi yake Lois. Maombi unayoyaomba leo yanaweza kuunda imani ya wajukuu na vitukuu ambao hutakutana nao kamwe upande huu wa umilele. Je, hiyo inabadilisha vipi thamani ya maombi yako ya kila siku?

Baba, {name} ni single na ulimwengu unasema hiyo inamaanisha kutokamilika. Lakini Neno Lako linasema {name} tayari ni kamili ndani Yako. Jaza {name} na kuridhika kwa kina kinachotokana na kufahamika kikamilifu na kupendwa kikamilifu na Muumba.

Bwana, {name} amechoka kusikia 'mtu wako yupo huko.' Huenda yupo, huenda hayupo. Kwa njia yoyote, utambulisho wa {name} hauko kwenye kusubiri. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kujenga maisha kamili sasa hivi, yakiwa yamejikita katika kusudi Lako.

Yesu, {name} anataka jamii ya kina lakini kuipata ni vigumu. Tuma urafiki wa kweli unaokaza na kudumisha. Acha {name} awe aina ya rafiki anayefaa kuwa nao, na umuongoze {name} kwa wengine wanaofanya vivyo hivyo.
Mungu, upande wa kitanda usio na mtu ni sauti kubwa usiku huu. {name} inaleta maumivu ya kutaka ushirika Kwako. Wewe si zawadi ya faraja; Wewe ni chanzo. Lakini tamaa ni halisi. Mshike {name} karibu.

Baba, katika utamaduni ulio na shauku na wanandoa, {name} wakati mwingine huhisi kama hayuko. Lakini Paulo aliita ujasiri kuwa zawadi katika 1 Wakorintho 7. Msaada {name} kufungua zawadi hiyo na kupata uhuru na umakini inayoleta kwa ajili ya Ufalme Wako.
Bwana, {name} anatoa muda wa kusubiri kwako. Iwe mwenzi anakuja mwaka ujao au kamwe, {name} anachagua kutegemea kwamba mpango Wako si wa pili bora. Mpe {name} amani katika kusubiri bila kikomo.
But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
verseText: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

templateText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
verseText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

templateText: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.
verseText: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

templateText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
verseText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

templateText: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
verseText: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

templateText: {name}, Yesu alikuwa single maisha yake yote duniani. Aliishi maisha kamili, yenye kusudi, yaliyojaa upendo katika historia ya binadamu bila mke. Ukosefu wa mwenzi haukumzuia, na haukukuzuia wewe. Ni kazi gani Mungu anakuachia mikono yako sasa hivi?

{name}, Ruth alishikilia Naomi katika msimu wake wa upweke zaidi na kusema, 'Mahali unapoenda, nitakwenda.' Jamii si kila wakati inaonekana kama mapenzi. Wakati mwingine, kuungana kwa kina kunakuja kupitia uaminifu usiotarajiwa. Nani Mungu amekuweka maishani kama Naomi au Ruth?
Upweke si kukosekana kwa kampuni; ni huzuni juu ya kukosekana kwa uhusiano. Mungu anatoa uhusiano wa kina zaidi ambao moyo wa kibinadamu unaweza kujua. — Elisabeth Elliot
Moyo wa mwanamke unapaswa kufichwa sana ndani ya Mungu kiasi kwamba mwanaume anahitaji kumtafuta ili kumwona. — Max Lucado

Bwana, ukungu wa katikati ya siku unakuja na umakini wa {name} unaporomoka. Ondoa machafuko ya kiakili. Pumzi moja, ukweli mmoja: Upo pamoja na {name} sasa hivi. Hiyo inatosha kumaliza jioni hii kwa nguvu.

Baba, {name} yuko katikati ya siku na tayari anajiuliza kuhusu maamuzi aliyofanya asubuhi. Badilisha mzunguko wa shaka na nanga moja: Unamwelekeza {name} katika hatua zake. Amini hilo na endelea mbele.

Yesu, mapumziko ya chakula cha mchana ni fursa ya kujaza roho, siyo mwili tu. Mlisha {name} kwa ukweli sasa hivi: {name} anaonekana, anapendwa, na ameandaliwa kwa ajili ya jioni hii. Nenda mbele ya {name} katika mkutano ujao, darasa linalofuata, mazungumzo yafuatayo.

Mungu, {name} anahisi hasira ya jioni ikipanda kutokana na mwingiliano usiofaa asubuhi. Kabla haijakua kubwa, ipunguze kwa amani Yako. Mpe {name} kiasi cha kujibu kwa neema, siyo kwa majibu ya haraka.
Baba, upungufu wa jioni ni halisi na pia ni wasiwasi kuhusu kazi zisizokamilika. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba uzalishaji si kitambulisho cha {name}. Pumua. Panga. Amini. Neema ya siku hii inatosha.
Bwana, {name} anahitaji sekunde 60 tu na Wewe sasa hivi. Katikati ya kelele, tarehe za mwisho, shinikizo: Upo hapa. Rejesha moyo wa {name}. Hiyo inatosha. Rudi kwenye hilo.
And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
verseText: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

templateText: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
verseText: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

templateText: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
verseText: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

templateText: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
verseText: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

templateText: {name}, Nehemia alichukua mapumziko ya maombi haraka katikati ya mazungumzo na mfalme kabla ya kujibu swali linalobadilisha maisha. 'Maombi ya mshale' yalibadilisha historia. Huhitaji saa moja; unahitaji wakati mfupi. Simama sasa hivi na tuma sentensi moja ya ukweli kwa Mungu.

{name}, Daniel aliomba mara tatu kwa siku, hata wakati ilikuwa haramu. Maombi ya katikati ya siku hayakuwa hiari kwake; ilikuwa ni kuishi. Je, ikiwa mapumziko haya mafupi hayakukatisha uzalishaji wako bali yanakupa nguvu? Rudi katikati na urudi ukiwa makini zaidi.

{name}, Yesu alijitenga katika maeneo ya upweke kuomba hata wakati umati ulipohitaji muda wake. Ikiwa Mwana wa Mungu alihitaji upweke wa katikati ya siku, ndivyo ilivyo kwako. Mapumziko haya si uvivu; ni jambo lenye uzalishaji zaidi utakalofanya jioni hii.
Alama ya mtu mkuu ni yule anayejua ni lini aweke kando mambo muhimu ili kufanikisha yale muhimu. — Brandon Sanderson
Rudi katikati. Rudi kwenye alama isiyohamishika. Katika harakati za siku yako, acha Mungu kuwa jicho la dhoruba. — A.W. Tozer

Bwana, nambari hazijakamilika na tumbo la {name} linajikaza kila wakati bili zinapofika. Wewe ni Mungu aliyemulika mikate na samaki. Ongeza rasilimali za {name} na mpe hekima kwa kila uamuzi wa kifedha.
Baba, {name} anazama katika deni na aibu inamfanya ajitenga. Ondoa aibu hiyo na uibadilishe na mpango. Mpe {name} nidhamu ya kuwa mwaminifu na kidogo na imani ya kuamini kwamba Utatoa yaliyobaki.

Yesu, {name} anataka kuwa mkarimu lakini uhaba unalia kwa sauti kubwa kuliko imani. Mfundishe {name} kwamba mikono iliyo wazi hupokea zaidi kuliko fist zilizoshikilia. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kutoa zaka wakati hesabu inasema hapana.

Mungu, {name} anakiri wasiwasi kwamba pesa imekuwa sanamu — ama katika wingi wake au ukosefu wake. Iondoe kwenye kiti. Mfundishe {name} kuridhika ambayo haitegemei salio la akaunti. Wewe ndiye hazina ya kweli.

Baba, {name} anaanza upya kifedha na inahisi kama kujenga kutoka kwenye majivu. Lakini Wewe unajulikana kwa mwanzo mpya. Mpe {name} kipato cha ubunifu, kibali kisichotarajiwa, na uvumilivu wa kujenga moja kwa moja kwa wakati.
Bwana, toa mahitaji ya kaya ya {name}. Chakula mezani, paa linaloshikilia, na vya kutosha kushiriki na wengine. {name} anakuamini kama Jehovah Jireh, Mungu anayemwona haja na kutoa kabla ya kusema.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
verseText: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

templateText: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
verseText: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

templateText: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
verseText: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

templateText: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
verseText: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

templateText: {name}, mjane katika 1 Wafalme 17 alikuwa na mkate mmoja tu wa unga na mafuta kidogo. Eliya alimuomba amfanyie mkate kwanza. Utii huo usio na mantiki ulifungua muujiza wa usambazaji ambao ulidumu katika njaa yote. Mungu anakuliza utoe nini ambacho kinaonekana kuwa hakika sasa hivi?

{name}, katika Mathayo 17 Yesu alimwambia Petro apate sarafu katika kinywa cha samaki ili kulipa kodi ya hekalu. Usambazaji huo ulikuwa wa ubunifu, usiotarajiwa, na wa kutosha. Ugavi wa Mungu hauji kila wakati kupitia njia unazotarajia. Kuwa wazi kwa usambazaji usio wa kawaida.

{name}, Wafilipi walitoa 'kutoka katika majaribu makali zaidi, furaha yao iliyozidi na umaskini wao wa kupindukia ulizalisha ukarimu mkubwa.' Ukarimu si kazi ya utajiri; ni kazi ya imani. Unaweza kutoa nini leo, hata kutoka katika uhaba?
Hana ujinga yule anayepewa kile asichoweza kushika ili kupata kile asichoweza kupoteza. — Jim Elliot
Kazi ya Mungu inayofanywa kwa njia ya Mungu haitakosa ugavi wa Mungu. — Hudson Taylor
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
verseText: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

templateText: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
verseText: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

templateText: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!” Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
verseText: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!” Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

templateText: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
verseText: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

templateText: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
verseText: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

templateText: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
verseText: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

templateText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
verseText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

templateText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
verseText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

templateText: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness. He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
verseText: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness. He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

templateText: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
verseText: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

templateText: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
verseText: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

templateText: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
verseText: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

templateText: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verseText: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

templateText: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
verseText: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.

templateText: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
verseText: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

templateText: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you. But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
verseText: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you. But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

templateText: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verseText: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

templateText: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
verseText: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

templateText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
verseText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

templateText: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verseText: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

templateText: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
verseText: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

templateText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verseText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

templateText: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
verseText: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

templateText: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
verseText: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

templateText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
verseText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

templateText: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verseText: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

templateText: Bwana, nguvu uhusiano kati ya {name} na mwenzi wao leo. Mahali ambapo kimya kimejenga kuta, acha maneno ya ukweli yaharibu. Msaada {name} kupenda si tu kwa hisia bali kwa kuchagua kila siku.
Baba, {name} anashikilia maneno ambayo yanapaswa kusemwa kwa neema. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kusema ukweli na upole wa kusema kwa upendo. Linda ndoa hii dhidi ya uchungu kuingia.

Yesu, ndoa ya {name} iko chini ya shinikizo la kifedha. Mahali ambapo pesa zinakandamiza mazungumzo, leta roho ya ushirikiano badala ya kulaumu. Msaada {name} na mwenzi wao kupanga pamoja, kumwamini Wewe pamoja, na kubeba uzito pamoja.

Mungu, {name} anahisi umbali ukiongezeka. Kile ambacho hapo awali kilihisi kuwa rahisi sasa kinahitaji juhudi. Fufua kitu halisi kati ya {name} na mwenzi wao usiku wa leo — si nostalgia, bali upendo wa kina uliojengwa kwa kuchagua tena.

Bwana, msamaha unahisi kuwa hauwezekani sasa kwa {name}. Jeraha bado ni jipya. Lakini Wewe ulisamehe kwa gharama kubwa zaidi, hivyo fundisha {name} jinsi ya kuachilia maumivu haya — si kwa sababu ilikuwa sawa, bali kwa sababu uhuru uko upande mwingine.

Baba, {name} anataka kukua kiroho pamoja na mwenzi wao lakini wako katika maeneo tofauti. Ondoa jaribu la kuhukumu au kukimbilia. Msaada {name} kuongoza kwa mfano na kuomba kwa uvumilivu, wakiamini wakati Wako kwa mioyo yote.

Yesu, {name} anawaza kuhusu mwelekeo wa familia. Je, tunafanya uchaguzi sahihi kwa watoto wetu? Tuliza mipango ya {name} iliyo na wasiwasi na ukumbushe kuwa Wewe ndiye Mwandishi wa kila sura katika hadithi ya familia hii.

Mungu, ndoa ya {name} inahisi kama kawaida, na {name} anahofia mwangaza unakufa. Lakini upendo wa kina si kila wakati unahisiwa — unajengwa. Msaada {name} kupata maana takatifu katika rhythm za kawaida za maisha yaliyoshirikiwa na roho nyingine.

Bwana, msaada {name} kusaidia ndoto za mwenzi wao hata wakati inagharimu faraja. Ndoa si watu wawili wanaoshuka ili kufaa — ni watu wawili wanaosaidiana kuwa wale ambao Uliwapa muundo. Mpe {name} roho ya ukarimu.

Baba, mgogoro umeingia nyumbani kwa {name} tena. Kabla ya maneno makali kuruka, ingilia kati. Punguza hasira, legeza mtazamo, na kumbusha {name} kwamba kushinda mjadala kamwe hakustahili kupoteza uhusiano. Leta amani usiku wa leo.

Yesu, {name} anahisi wasiwasi kuhusu kutoa kwa familia hii. Bill zinashinikiza na mazungumzo kuhusu pesa yanamalizika kwa mvutano. Kuwa mtoa wa {name} na mpatanishi. Badilisha hofu na mpango na hofu na maombi.

templateText: Bwana, {name} amechoka kutokana na malezi ya watoto leo. Uvumilivu umekwisha muda mrefu. Rejesha kile kilichotumika. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba mzazi aliyechoka anayeendelea kujitolea bado ni mwaminifu machoni Mwako.

Baba, {name} anahofia kuhusu siku zijazo za watoto hawa. Je, watakuwa salama? Je, watakupata? Chukua mawazo ya {name} yanayozunguka na uyafunge katika ukweli kwamba unawapenda watoto hawa hata zaidi kuliko {name} anavyowapenda.

Yesu, {name} amepoteza hasira yake na watoto tena. Hatia ni nzito. Lakini aibu si kutoka Kwako. Msaidie {name} kuomba msamaha kwa dhati, kuonyesha unyenyekevu, na kupokea neema Yako inayofanya kila asubuhi iwe mpya kwa dhati.

Mungu, {name} anataka kulea watoto wanaokujua — si tu kujua kuhusu Wewe. Mwonyeshe {name} jinsi ya kufanya imani iwe halisi katika meza ya chakula, ndani ya gari, katika hadithi za kulala. Wacha watoto hawa wakukuone katika uaminifu wa kawaida wa {name}.

Bwana, mtoto wa {name} anashida na {name} hawezi kuirekebisha. Kukosa uwezo kunakata tamaa. Kuwa Mponyaji pale {name} anaweza kushika tu mkono. Kuwa Mlinzi pale {name} anaweza kusimama karibu tu. Fanya kazi pale mikono ya mzazi haiwezi kufikia.

Baba, nidhamu inahisi kama nyaya ngumu kwa {name}. Ikiwa ni kali sana, uhusiano unavunjika; ikiwa ni laini sana, mipaka inayeyuka. Mpe {name} hekima ya kurekebisha kwa upendo na nguvu kwa pumzi moja, kama unavyofanya nasi.

Yesu, {name} anashuku kama wanavyofanya mzazi huyu ni sahihi. Kila familia nyingine inaonekana kuwa na mpangilio mzuri zaidi. Nyamazisha kulinganisha na sema ukweli: {name} alichaguliwa na Wewe kwa watoto hawa maalum. Hilo linatosha.

Mungu, {name} anajifunza kuachilia kadri watoto wanavyokua. Ushikaji unalegea lakini upendo haupotei. Mfundishe {name} kwamba kuachilia udhibiti si kuacha — ni kuamini kwamba Wewe utawachunga wanaposhindwa {name}.

Bwana, shinikizo la kifedha la kulea familia linamkandamiza {name} leo. Mavazi, ada, chakula — halikomi. Ulilisha watu elfu tano kwa chakula cha mvulana. Ongeza kile {name} alichonacho na badilisha wasiwasi na imani.

Baba, uhusiano wa {name} na mtoto wake unahisi kuwa na msongo. Uhusiano ambao hapo awali ulikuja kwa urahisi sasa unahitaji juhudi. Punguza mioyo yote. Fungua mlango wa mazungumzo halisi leo. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba kamwe si too late kujenga upya.

Yesu, {name} amechoka kimwili kutokana na mahitaji ya kuwajali watoto wadogo. Imarisha mikono hii, thibitisha miguu hii. Wacha {name} aone kila kitendo kidogo cha huduma kama ibada — kazi takatifu inayofanywa kwa hadhira ya Mmoja.

Mungu, {name} anajiuliza kama imani ina maana kwa kizazi kijacho. Sauti ya ulimwengu ni kubwa sana. Lakini Neno Lako halirudi bure. Kila maombi yanayombwa, kila mistari inayosemwa wakati wa kulala — hakuna hata moja inayoenda bure. Imarisha tumaini la {name}.

templateText: Bwana, {name} anatazama vitabu vya masomo na maneno yanachanganyika. Shinikizo la masomo linahisi kuwa gumu usiku huu. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba akili ni zawadi kutoka Kwako, na alama si kipimo cha thamani. Toa umakini na pumziko.

Baba, {name} anahisi uzito wa matarajio ya kila mtu — wahadhiri, wazazi, wenzao. Kata kati ya kelele na ongea juu ya utambulisho wa {name}: amechaguliwa, anapendwa, anatosha. Si kwa sababu ya utendaji bali kwa sababu ya kile Unachosema {name} ni.
Yesu, {name} amezungukwa na sauti zinazodharau imani kama ya kijinga. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kushikilia imani na akili kwa mkono mmoja. Wewe hauko hatarini na maswali — unapatikana ndani yao.

Mungu, {name} hana wazo la kufanya nini baada ya kuhitimu. Baadaye ni ukurasa mweupe na hiyo inatia hofu. Lakini Uliandika kila sura kabla ya moja kuja kuwa. Msaada {name} kuchukua hatua inayofuata bila kuhitaji kuona ngazi nzima.

Bwana, mzigo wa kifedha wa kuwa mwanafunzi ni halisi kwa {name}. Ada, kodi, chakula — hesabu haifanyi kazi kamwe. Lakini Wewe ni Mungu anayezidisha mikate. Toa kwa {name} kwa njia zinazojenga imani, si tu akaunti za benki.

Baba, upweke umemfuata {name} chuoni. Amezungukwa na watu lakini anajulikana na wachache. Mwongoze {name} kwenye jamii halisi — si tu mizunguko ya kijamii bali nafsi zitakazomshughulikia na kumtia nguvu. Vunja upweke leo.

Yesu, shinikizo la rika ni kubwa na {name} amechoka kupinga. Kile kinachohisi kama uhuru kwa wengine kinahisi kama mtego kwa roho ya {name}. Imarisha azma. Msaada {name} kupata ujasiri katika dhamira, si katika kufuata.
Mungu, {name} ana uamuzi wa kufanya na kila chaguo linaonekana kuwa na shaka. Kazi, taaluma, uhusiano — makutano yanazidi kuongezeka. Mpe {name} si ramani bali dira: Amani Yako ikielekeza njia mbele.

Bwana, {name} amepiga usiku mwingine wa kuchelewa na mshumaa unawaka pande zote mbili. Linda mwili na akili ya {name} kutokana na gharama ya msimu huu. Nyenyekea kwamba pumziko si uvivu — ni utiifu kwa Mungu aliyepanga Sabato.

templateText: Bwana, {name} analinganisha njia yao na za wengine. Mitandao ya kijamii inaonyesha kile {name} anachokosa. Tuliza mzunguko na ongea thamani katika moyo wa {name}. Mbio si dhidi ya wanafunzi wenzako — ni ile uliyoiweka mbele ya {name} pekee.

Bwana, {name} anaelekea Jumatatu nyingine. Kabla ya barua pepe kujaa na mikutano kuchukua nguvu, thibitisha utambulisho wa {name} ndani Yako — si katika uzalishaji, si katika utendaji. {name} ni Wako kwanza.

Baba, {name} anakabiliana na mfanyakazi mgumu na chuki inajitokeza. Mpe {name} macho ya kuona mtu huyu kama Wewe unavyomwona — mtu anayebeba mizigo yao wenyewe. Badilisha hasira na huruma isiyotarajiwa.

Yesu, kuchoka si alama ya heshima — ni ishara ya onyo. {name} amekuwa akikimbia bila mafuta kwa muda mrefu. Mpe {name} ruhusa ya kupunguza kasi na hekima ya kuweka mipaka inayolinda nafsi bila kuacha wajibu.

Mungu, {name} anakabiliana na tatizo la kimaadili kazini. Njia rahisi inakabiliwa na uaminifu; njia sahihi inaweza kugharimu kitu. Kuwa ujasiri wa {name}. Acha {name} achague kile kilicho sahihi badala ya kile kilicho rahisi, akimtegemea Wewe kwa matokeo.

Bwana, tamaa na kuridhika vinavuta {name} katika mwelekeo tofauti. Je, ni makosa kutaka zaidi? Je, ni kukosa imani kuwa na kuridhika? Msaidie {name} kufuata ubora bila kufanya sanamu ya mafanikio. Mfundishe {name} tamaa takatifu.

Baba, uwiano wa kazi na maisha ya {name} uko vibaya. Kazi inachukua kila kitu na watu wanaohusika zaidi wanapata mabaki. Panga upya vipaumbele vya {name} leo. Kazi ni zawadi, lakini haikupaswa kuwa hadithi nzima.

Yesu, {name} anajisikia kupuuziliwa mbali kazini. Juhudi hazionekani, uhamasishaji unakwenda kwa mtu mwingine. Lakini Wewe unaona kila saa ya uaminifu. Msaidie {name} kufanya kazi kama kwa ajili Yako, si kwa ajili ya sifa za kibinadamu bali kwa hadhira ya Mmoja ambaye kamwe hasahau.

Mungu, {name} anabeba hasira dhidi ya uongozi unaofanya maamuzi bila kujali watu wanaoathirika. Linda moyo wa {name} dhidi ya uchungu. Mpe {name} hekima ya kutetea kile kilicho sahihi na amani ya kuachilia kile hakiwezi kubadilishwa.

Bwana, {name} anajiuliza ikiwa kazi hii kweli ni njia sahihi. Malipo yanakuja lakini kusudi linaonekana tupu. Nena kwa wazi. Ikiwa hapa ndipo Umemweka {name}, fanya upya mwito. Ikiwa ni wakati wa kuhamasika, mpe {name} ujasiri wa kuchukua hatua.

Baba, fedha za {name} ni ngumu licha ya kufanya kazi kwa bidii. Tofauti kati ya mapato na matumizi inaunda msongo wa mawazo wa kudumu. Wewe ni Jehovah Jireh — Mungu anayetoa. Fungua milango {name} asiyoweza kuona na leta usambazaji kutoka mahali pasipo tarajiwa.

templateText: Bwana, {name} anaanza upya na ukurasa mweupe unatia hofu. Kila kitu kilichojengwa kimeanguka. Lakini Wewe unajitahidi katika uumbaji kutoka kwa chochote. Pumua uhai katika mwanzo mpya wa {name} kama vile ulivyopumua uhai katika vumbi.

Baba, yaliyopita yanaendelea kumvuta {name} nyuma. Kukosa matumaini kunaendelea kurudiwa. Kata mnyororo kati ya {name} na kile kilichopita. Unafanya mambo yote kuwa mapya — si mambo mapya yote — hivyo chukua kilichovunjika na kukirekebisha.

Yesu, {name} anajisikia kama mshindwa. Neno hilo linakalia sauti zaidi ya maombi yoyote. Nyamazisha kwa ukweli: kushindwa ni tukio, si kitambulisho. {name} si kile kilichotokea — {name} ni kile unachosema ni. Nena hilo kwa sauti kubwa leo.

Mungu, kujenga tena uaminifu kunachukua muda mrefu zaidi kuliko {name} alivyotarajia. Watu ni waangalifu, na upweke wa kurejesha uaminifu ni halisi. Mpe {name} uvumilivu katika mchakato na neema ya kuendelea kujitokeza hata wakati maendeleo hayaonekani.

Bwana, {name} amepoteza jamii ambayo hapo awali ilihisi kama nyumbani. Kuanzia upya kunamaanisha kupata watu wapya, midundo mipya, kuhusika mpya. Mwongoze {name} kwenye meza ambapo kuna kiti kisicho na mtu na ukaribisho wa kweli unakusubiri.

Baba, {name} anajenga upya kifedha kutoka mwanzo. Nambari hizo zinashangaza na kiburi kimejeruhiwa. Lakini unavaa maua na kulisha ndege. {name} anastahili zaidi ya hapo. Toa hatua kwa hatua kadri {name} anavyojenga tena kwa matofali.

Yesu, {name} anaogopa kujaribu tena. Mara ya mwisho ilimalizika kwa maumivu na hofu ya kuanguka tena inakera. Mpe {name} ujasiri ambao si ukosefu wa hofu bali uamuzi kwamba kusonga mbele ni muhimu zaidi kuliko kubaki salama.

Mungu, hasira inabaki kutokana na kile kilichotokea. {name} hakuchagua kuanza upya — ililazimishwa na chaguo za mtu mwingine. Lakini kubeba chuki kutaharibu msimu mpya. Msaidie {name} kuomboleza kwa ukweli na kisha, wakati wa tayari, kuachilia kwa Wewe.

Bwana, {name} anajiuliza ikiwa nafasi ya pili ni halisi. Je, kuanza upya kunamaanisha kudanganya kwamba sura ya kwanza haikutokea? Hapana — inamaanisha Mwandishi hajamaliza kuandika. Geuza ukurasa huu pamoja na {name} na acha sura inayofuata iwe tajiri zaidi kwa maumivu.

Baba, {name} anahuzunisha maisha yaliyokuwa. Sio tu mtu au mahali, bali toleo la nafsi zao lililokuwepo katika ulimwengu huo wa zamani. Msaidie {name} kuomboleza bila kukwama na kugundua ni nani wanakuwa katika huu mpya.

Yesu, {name} anahisi upweke wa mwanzo huu mpya zaidi usiku. Wakati dunia inakuwa kimya, ukosefu wa kitu unazungumza kwa sauti kubwa. Kuwa mwenzi wa {name} katika masaa haya ya kimya. Jaza nafasi hiyo si kwa kelele bali kwa uwepo Wako.

Mungu, {name} anagundua kwamba kuanza upya si wakati mmoja bali chaguo la kila siku. Kila asubuhi ni ufufuo mdogo. Mpe {name} nguvu ya kuendelea kuchagua maisha, kuendelea kuchagua mbele, kuendelea kuchagua Wewe, siku moja kwa wakati.

templateText: Bwana, {name} anatembea kupitia bonde ambalo halionekani mwisho. Kuteseka si nadharia — ni hisia na ya kila siku. Kuwa karibu. Si kwa majibu, bali kwa uwepo. {name} anahitaji kujua uko hapa katika giza hili.

Baba, {name} aliomba na hakuna kilichobadilika. Kimya kutoka mbinguni ni kizito. Lakini {name} anachagua kuendelea kugonga mlango hata wakati inahisi kama imefungwa. Zawadi hii uvumilivu. Vunja kimya kwa hata sauti ya busara ya sauti Yako.

Yesu, mwili wa {name} unashindwa na utambuzi ni mzito. Pale dawa inapoishia, nguvu Yako haina mipaka. Iwe unaponya katika maisha haya au yajayo, mshike {name} imara. Mpe uvumilivu wa leo. Hiyo inatosha.

Mungu, {name} amekasirika nawe na anaogopa kusema kwa sauti. Lakini unaweza kubeba ukweli. Wewe si dhaifu. Pokea kilio cha {name} kisicho na kuchujwa na usiachilie mpaka kitu kibadilike — hata kama kinachobadilika ni kushikilia kwa {name}, si hali.

Bwana, {name} anashikilia ahadi Zako usiku huu ingawa zinahisi kama kuta za karatasi dhidi ya kimbunga. Lakini Neno Lako halirudi bure. Hivyo {name} atapanda ahadi hizi kama mbegu katika ardhi ngumu na kuamini kwamba mvua inakuja.

Baba, {name} amejitenga katika maumivu haya. Wengine wamesonga mbele, lakini huzuni inakalia kama siku ya kwanza. Usimruhusu {name} kuteseka peke yake. Tuma mtu ambaye hatajaribu kuirekebisha lakini atakaa tu katika majivu pamoja na {name}.

Yesu, imani ya {name} inaonekana kama inaning'inia kwa nyuzi. Si kwa sababu {name} anataka kuondoka, bali kwa sababu maumivu yanaufanya iwe vigumu kukiona. Mkutanishe {name} si kwenye kilele bali katika bonde — hapo ndipo uliahidi kutembea.

Mungu, {name} haelewi kwa nini hii inatokea. 'Kwa nini' huenda isijitokeze upande huu wa mbingu. Lakini msaada {name} kubadilisha swali 'kwa nini mimi' kuwa maombi 'sasa nini.' Elekeza hatua inayofuata ya {name} hata bila ramani kamili.

Bwana, {name} anashikilia ahadi Zako usiku huu ingawa zinahisi kama kuta za karatasi dhidi ya kimbunga. Lakini Neno Lako halirudi bure. Hivyo {name} atapanda ahadi hizi kama mbegu katika ardhi ngumu na kuamini kwamba mvua inakuja.

Baba, wasiwasi umekuwa mwenzako wa kudumu {name} katika msimu huu mgumu. Kila wazo linazunguka, kila hali inakuwa giza. Vunja mzunguko. Muweke {name} katika wakati huu wa sasa ambapo neema Yako inatosha — si kesho, si wiki ijayo — sasa.

templateText: Baba, {name} anahisi joto la hasira likiongezeka. Kabla ya neno moja kutoroka, linda kinywa cha {name} na thibitisha mapigo yake ya moyo. Badilisha moto huu kwa uvumilivu Wako — pole kwa hasira, tajiri kwa upendo.
Yesu, {name} amekuwa akishikilia chuki kama fist iliyoshikiliwa. Fungua vidole hivyo. Msaidie {name} kuachilia kila chuki na kuamini kwamba kulipiza kisasi ni kwako, si kwetu.

Mungu, {name} amekasirishwa na ukosefu wa haki katika ulimwengu huu. Hasira hiyo si mbaya — Wewe unachukia dhuluma pia. Elekeza hasira ya {name} katika hatua, si uharibifu. Acha hasira ya haki izalisha matunda ya haki.

Roho Mtakatifu, watoto wa {name} wanajaribu kila neva ya mwisho leo. Kabla {name} hajakata, jaza nyumba hii kwa upole. Msaidie {name} kufundisha kwa upendo, si hasira, na kuonyesha uvumilivu unaotonyesha kwetu kila siku.
Baba wa mbinguni, {name} amekasirishwa na Wewe na anaogopa kukiri. Lakini unaweza kushughulikia ukweli. Ulipokea vilio vya Ayubu na hasira ya Daudi. Sikiliza maneno ya {name} ya kweli na usiache.
Bwana, mwenzi wa {name} alisema kitu kilichokata sana na jeraha bado linavuja damu. Ponya maumivu kabla hayajawa chuki. Mpe {name} neema ya kusema ukweli kwa upole, si kwa kulipiza kisasi.

Baba, {name} anabeba hasira kutoka kwa maisha ya zamani katika mwanzo huu mpya. Moto huo unachoma madaraja {name} bado anahitaji. Mimina maji baridi juu ya makaa na mpe {name} mwanzo mpya — si tu katika hali bali pia katika roho.

Mungu, kukasirisha kazini ni halisi kwa {name}. Matibabu yasiyo ya haki, michango isiyoonekana, ahadi zilizovunjika. Kabla {name} hajatumia barua pepe hiyo, piga pause. Acha hekima iseme kwa sauti kubwa kuliko hasira.

Yesu, {name} anarejea kwenye ugumu mara kwa mara. Majibu yaliyopangwa, kukutana kwa mawazo — yanachukua usingizi na kuiba amani. Vunja mzunguko usiku wa leo. Acha {name} aweke chini na kupumzika kweli.
Roho Mtakatifu, {name} ni mdogo na hasira inahisi kuwa kubwa. Mfundishe {name} kwamba kuwa polepole kwa hasira si udhaifu — ni nguvu ya mtu anayemwamini Mungu mwenye nguvu kupigana vita vyao.

templateText: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

templateText: {name}, Musa alipiga mwamba kwa hasira badala ya kuzungumza nalo — na hiyo ilimgharimu Nchi ya Ahadi (Hesabu 20:11-12). Je, mara ngapi tunaruhusu hasira ya muda mfupi kuiba kitu cha thamani? Hasira isiyodhibitiwa imemgharimu nini?

{name}, Yesu aligeuza meza za wabadilishaji fedha kwa hasira ya haki (Yohana 2:15). Si kila hasira ni dhambi. Muhimu ni nini kinachoiendesha — kiburi cha kujitafutia au upendo wa kweli kwa kile kilicho sawa. Ni aina gani unayoibeba leo?

{name}, Yona aliketi chini ya mzabibu uliokufa, akiwa na hasira kwa Mungu kwa sababu ya kuonyesha rehema kwa Ninawi (Yona 4:9). Wakati mwingine hasira zetu zinaonyesha kwamba tunataka haki kwa wengine lakini neema kwa sisi wenyewe. Hapo kuna ukweli gani katika maisha yako?

{name}, hasira ya Kaini ilichoma sana hadi ikasababisha mauaji (Mwanzo 4:6-7). Mungu alimwonya: dhambi ilikuwa inakung'ang'ania mlangoni. Hasira isiyodhibitiwa kila wakati huongezeka. Nini kinachokung'ang'ania mlangoni mwako sasa hivi?
"Hasira ni asidi inayoweza kuleta madhara zaidi kwa chombo ambacho inahifadhiwa kuliko kwa chochote ambacho inamwagika." — Mark Twain
"Msamaha si kitendo cha mara kwa mara; ni mtazamo wa kudumu." — Martin Luther King Jr.
{name}, Yakobo 1:20 inasema hasira ya kibinadamu haileti haki ya Mungu. Fikiria kuhusu hasira yako ya mwisho — je, ilikukaribisha karibu na mtu unayetaka kuwa, au ikakufanya uwe mbali zaidi?
{name}, Waefeso 4:26 inaruhusu hasira lakini inaweka muda: kabla ya jua kuzama. Itakuwaje kutatua kukasirisha kwa leo kabla ya kufunga macho yako usiku huu?
Baba, {name} yuko katika mtego wa majaribu sasa hivi. Kuvuta ni kubwa na visingizio ni vingi. Toa njia ya kutoroka uliyowaahidi na mpe {name} ujasiri wa kuichukua.

Yesu, {name} anaendelea kuanguka katika mtindo ule ule. Aibu baada ya hapo ni kubwa. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba rehema zako ni mpya asubuhi hii — si kwa sababu dhambi ni ndogo, bali kwa sababu neema Yako ni kubwa hivyo.

Mungu, {name} anajisikia peke yake katika mapambano haya. Hakuna anayeijua na siri hiyo inafanya kuwa mbaya zaidi. Mpe {name} mtu mmoja salama wa kumweleza — uwajibikaji ulio na mizizi katika neema, si hukumu.
Roho Mtakatifu, renew {name}'s mind today. Replace the lies — "just this once," "no one will know," "you deserve it" — with the truth of who {name} is in Christ: holy, free, and dearly loved.
Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anaanza upya na tabia za zamani zinakabili. Jiji jipya, maisha mapya — lakini majaribu yale yale yanafuata. Jenga ukuta wa ulinzi kuzunguka mwanzo mpya wa {name}.

Bwana, {name} amezungukwa na shinikizo la kukubali katika shule. Wengine wote wanaonekana hawana wasiwasi, na kusimama imara kunaweza kuonekana kama kutengwa. Kuwa nguvu ya {name} wakati shinikizo la rika linakuwa kubwa.
Baba, ndoa ya {name} inajaribiwa. Nyasi zinaonekana kuwa za kijani mahali pengine. Fumba macho ya {name} kwa udanganyifu na fungua macho ya {name} kwa zawadi iliyo tayari nyumbani. Linda agano hili.
Mungu, usiku wa kuchelewa na mwangaza wa skrini unamvuta {name} katika maeneo yanayoacha tupu. Badilisha furaha ya muda mfupi na kuridhika kwa kina. {name} aliumbwa kwa zaidi ya haya.

Yesu, jaribu la kukata kona kazini ni gumu kwa {name}. Wengine wote wanafanya hivyo. Lakini uaminifu wa {name} hauwezi kuuzwa. Imarisha azma ya {name} kufanya yaliyo sawa hata wakati hakuna anayekangalia.

Roho Mtakatifu, katika msimu huu mgumu {name} anajaribiwa kupunguza maumivu kwa chochote kinachotoa faraja ya haraka. Kuwa faraja inayoridhisha kweli. Mkutane {name} katika maumivu kabla ya udanganyifu kufanya hivyo.

No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
verseText: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

templateText: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verseText: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

templateText: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
verseText: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

templateText: {name}, Yusufu alikimbia kutoka kwa mke wa Potifari — kwa kweli aliacha koti lake nyuma (Mwanzo 39:12). Wakati mwingine jambo la kimungu unaloweza kufanya ni kukimbia. Ni hali gani unahitaji kuondoka kimwili?

{name}, Yesu alikabiliwa na majaribu ya siku 40 katika jangwa na alikabiliana na kila uongo kwa Neno (Mathayo 4:1-11). Alikuwa na njaa, ameisha nguvu, peke yake — lakini alisimama. Haupigani kwa nguvu zako mwenyewe. Ni andiko gani unaweza kujihami nalo leo?

{name}, kushindwa kubwa kwa Daudi kulianza na matembezi yasiyo na kazi juu ya paa (2 Samweli 11:2). Jaribu mara nyingi huja tunapokuwa hatuna shughuli na hatuna ulinzi. Ni hatua gani za kujikinga unaweza kujenga katika masaa yako yasiyo na kazi?

{name}, Petro alijivunia kwamba hatamkana Yesu, kisha alikumbwa na shinikizo mara tatu (Luka 22:34). Kujiona kuwa na uwezo kupita kiasi ni rafiki wa jaribu. Wapi unaweza kuwa unadharaulisha udhaifu wako mwenyewe?
"Jaribu si dhambi; ni wito wa vita." — Erwin Lutzer
"Tumeokoka sana ili kufurahia dhambi, na tunapenda dhambi sana ili kufurahia Ukristo." — C.S. Lewis

{name}, 1 Wakorintho 10:13 inahidi njia ya kutoroka na kila jaribu. Kumbuka wakati wa mwisho ulipokata tamaa — je, kulikuwa na mlango uliochagua kutokupita? Kuondoka kwa mlango huo kutakuwa vipi wakati ujao?

{name}, Waebrania 4:15 inasema Yesu alijaribiwa kwa kila njia lakini hakufanya dhambi. Anaelewa mapambano yako bila kukuhukumu kwa ajili yake. Kujuaje kwamba amepitia hapo kunabadilisha jinsi unavyomleta hili kwake?
Baba, {name} aliamka na kwa muda mmoja alisahau kupoteza — kisha ilirudi kwa nguvu. Kuwa katika wakati huo mgumu wa kukumbuka. Msaada {name} kupitia masaa ya kwanza ya siku nyingine bila yao.

Yesu, mikono ya {name} inasumbuka kwa mtoto ambaye hawakupata kumshika. Huzuni hii haina kikundi cha chakula, hakuna maua ya mazishi. Lakini Wewe unaona maombolezo ambayo hakuna mwingine anayekubali. Fariji {name} katika huzuni hii ya kimya.

Mungu, {name} anahuzunika kwa ndoto iliyokufa — siku zijazo ambazo hazitakuwepo. Inahisi kuwa ya kipumbavu kuomboleza kitu ambacho hakikuwahi kuwepo, lakini kupoteza ni halisi. Thibitisha maumivu ya {name} na panda tumaini jipya katika udongo ulio tupu.

Baba wa mbinguni, {name} aliona mwenzi wa miongo kadhaa akiteleza mbali na kimya katika nyumba ni kizito. Jaza kiti kilichokuwa tupu, upande baridi wa kitanda, asubuhi za kimya na uwepo Wako wa dhahiri. Kuwa karibu na {name} usiku huu.

Bwana, likizo ni ngumu zaidi kwa {name}. Kiti kilichokuwa tupu mezani, zawadi bila mtu wa kumkabidhi. Kuwa karibu hasa katika mashambulizi haya ya kalenda. Acha {name} ahuzunike na kusherehekea kwa wakati mmoja.

Roho Mtakatifu, machozi ya {name} yanaonekana yasiyokuwa na mwisho lakini Unakusanya kila moja. Huzuni hii haitapotea. Siku moja Utageuza maombolezo haya kuwa dansi. Mpaka wakati huo, densi na {name} katika mvua.

Baba, mtoto wa {name} anahuzunika kwa kupoteza ambacho hawawezi kuelewa kikamilifu. Mpe {name} hekima ya kuelezea mbingu kwa mioyo midogo na nguvu ya kuomboleza huku bado akiwa mkono thabiti wanahitaji.
Mungu, {name} alipoteza mzazi na dunia iliendelea kuzunguka. Jinsi gani kila kitu kinaweza kuwa cha kawaida wakati msingi wa {name} umepasuka? Shikilia {name} katika ukweli huu wa kutatanisha.
Yesu, miaka imepita lakini huzuni ya {name} inashambulia bila onyo — wimbo, harufu, picha. Fanya mawimbi haya kuwa ya kawaida kwa {name}. Huzuni si ishara ya imani dhaifu; ni echo ya upendo wa kina.
Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anaanza upya baada ya kupoteza na anajiuliza ikiwa ni usaliti kuhisi furaha tena. Mwondoee {name} hatia. Furaha haiifuti yule aliyepotea — inaheshimu maisha waliyoyaishi.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verseText: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

templateText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verseText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

templateText: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
verseText: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

templateText: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
verseText: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

templateText: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.
verseText: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.

templateText: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verseText: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

templateText: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verseText: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

templateText: {name}, wakati Lazaro alikufa, Yesu hakuenda haraka kueleza au kurekebisha. Alilia (Yohana 11:35). Mungu wa ulimwengu alisimama kwenye kaburi na kulia. Machozi yako si kushindwa kwa imani — ni ushahidi kwamba ulipenda vizuri. Unahitaji kuomboleza bila kuomba msamaha leo?

{name}, Daudi alitupa huzuni ya kweli wakati mtoto wake alikufa, kisha alisimama, akaosha, na kuabudu (2 Samweli 12:20). Huzuni na ibada vinaweza kuishi katika moyo mmoja. Unaweza vipi kuleta huzuni yako mbele za Mungu kama kitendo cha imani leo?

{name}, Naomi alipoteza mumewe na wana wote wawili, kisha aliwaambia wote wampige jina "Mchungu" (Ruth 1:20). Lakini Mungu alikuwa kimya akiandika hadithi ya ukombozi ambayo hakuweza kuona. Mungu anaweza kuwa anaandika nini katika sura yako ya kupoteza?

{name}, Paulo alisema kuomboleza lakini si kama wale wasio na matumaini (1 Wathesalonike 4:13). Tofauti si maumivu kidogo — ni upeo. Unaruhusiwa kuumia na bado kutazamia mbele. Unashikaje mambo yote mawili leo?
"Hakuna huzuni kama huzuni isiyozungumza." — Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
"Huzuni si ishara ya udhaifu, wala ukosefu wa imani. Ni gharama ya upendo." — Elisabeth Elliot

{name}, Zaburi 56:8 inasema Mungu anashika machozi yako kwenye chupa. Hakuna hata moja inayoenda bila kuonekana. Ni huzuni gani umekuwa ukiibeba kimya ambayo unahitaji kuileta mbele Yake usiku wa leo?
{name}, Mhubiri 3:4 inasema kuna wakati wa kulia na wakati wa kucheka, wakati wa kuomboleza na wakati wa kucheza. Wakati huu ni upi kwako? Na unaweza kuamini kwamba wakati mwingine unakuja?

Baba, mwili wa {name} unashindwa na unahisi kama usaliti. Utambuzi unakaribia na hofu inasema mabaya zaidi. Imarisha moyo wa {name} wakati unasubiri majibu. Uwe amani inayozidi ripoti zote za matibabu.
Yesu, {name} amechoka kutokana na maumivu ya muda mrefu ambayo hayaondoki kabisa. Wakati uponyaji hauji kwa wakati wa {name}, uwe neema inayotosha. Beba kile {name} hakiwezi kubeba.

Mungu, {name} anatazama akili ya mzazi ikiteleza mbali kumbukumbu moja baada ya nyingine. Mabadiliko ya majukumu ni ya kusikitisha. Mpe {name} uvumilivu kwa maswali yanayojirudia na upole kwa nyakati za ufahamu.

Roho Mtakatifu, afya ya akili ya {name} ni vita ambavyo hakuna anayeweza kuona. Majeraha yasiyoonekana ni halisi kama yale yanayoonekana. Inua ukungu, legeza uzito, na kumbusha {name} kwamba kupata msaada ni kitendo cha imani, si ishara ya kushindwa.

Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anatembea bila nguvu — akijaribu kazi na huduma ya kulea na kulala kidogo. Kabla ya {name} kumwaga kwa wengine, mwagie {name} kwanza. Hata Yesu alipumzika. Mpe ruhusa kufanya vivyo hivyo.

Bwana, hospitali ni baridi na pekee na {name} hawezi kulala kwa sauti zote za beep. Uwe uwepo wa joto katika chumba hiki kisichokuwa na uchafu. Acha {name} ahisi ukaribu Wako zaidi ya sindano na kelele.

Baba, mwili wa {name} unazeeka na hauwezi kufanya kile ulichokuwa ukifanya, na kukasirisha ni halisi. Msaada {name} apate heshima katika msimu huu mpya na aamini kwamba nguvu inakamilishwa katika udhaifu.
Mungu, {name} anasali kwa ajili ya uponyaji na kimya kinahisi kuwa kizito. Je, ni hapana au bado? Katika hali yoyote, {name} anachagua kuamini. Lakini ni vigumu. Mkutane {name} katika ugumu.
Yesu, mwenzi wa {name} ni mgonjwa na {name} anahisi kutokuwa na uwezo akiwa pembeni. Mpe hekima ya kusema, nguvu ya kufanya, na amani kwa kile ambacho kiko nje ya udhibiti wa {name}.

Roho Mtakatifu, mtoto wa {name} si mzima na hofu mbaya za mzazi zinapiga kelele. Nyamazisha hofu hiyo kwa sauti Yako ndogo ya kimya. Onyesha mikono ya madaktari na linda imani ya {name} kupitia dhoruba.
He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
verseText: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

templateText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verseText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

templateText: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
verseText: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

templateText: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
verseText: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

templateText: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
verseText: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.

templateText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
verseText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

templateText: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
verseText: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

templateText: {name}, mwanamke aliyemwaga damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili alitumia kila kitu kwa madaktari na alizidi kuwa mbaya — hadi alipogusa pindo la mavazi ya Yesu (Marko 5:25-29). Wakati dawa imekukosea, Mponyaji hajakukosea. Kuonekana kwake Yeye kutakuwa vipi kwako leo?

{name}, Paulo alikuwa na mwiba katika mwili ambao alimsihi Mungu aondoe mara tatu. Mungu alisema hapana — lakini alitoa kitu bora: neema inayotosha (2 Wakorintho 12:8-9). Je, ni nini kama sala yako isiyo na majibu ni kweli jibu lililofichwa?

{name}, wakati marafiki wa kipooze walishindwa kupita umati, walivunja paa (Marko 2:4). Wakati mwingine uponyaji unahitaji watu wanaotaka kukubeba wakati huwezi kutembea mwenyewe. Ni nani wanaovunja paa yako?

{name}, Hezekia alielezwa kwamba atakufa, akageuza uso wake kwenye ukuta, na kulia mbele za Mungu — na Mungu akaongeza miaka kumi na tano (Isaya 38:1-5). Maombi ya ujasiri si yasiyo ya heshima; ni ya karibu. Ni ombi gani la ujasiri unaloshikilia nyuma?
"Mungu kamwe hafanyi maumivu kuwa bure. Daima anatumia ili kutimiza kusudi Lake." — Jerry Bridges
"Nimejifunza kushikilia mambo yote kwa urahisi, ili Mungu asihitaji kuyatoa kutoka mikononi mwangu." — Corrie ten Boom

{name}, 2 Wakorintho 12:9 inasema nguvu ya Mungu inakamilishwa katika udhaifu. Hii si kauli ya kawaida — ni mwaliko. Wapi katika mapambano yako ya afya unaweza kuwa unajaribu kuwa na nguvu wakati Mungu anakuita uwe mkweli kuhusu udhaifu wako?
{name}, Zaburi 139:14 inasema umetengenezwa kwa hofu na ajabu. Hata wakati mwili wako hauhisi kuwa wa ajabu, ufundi wa Muumba haujabadilika. Unaweza vipi kuheshimu mwili wako kama kazi Yake leo?
Baba, {name} yuko peke yake usiku wa leo na kimya ni kizito. Si aina ya amani — ni ile inayosikika kwa kukosekana. Uwe kampuni {name} anayotamani. Jaza chumba hiki kwa uwepo Wako usiopingika.

Yesu, {name} amehama kwenda jiji jipya na hajui mtu yeyote. Mitaa isiyo ya kawaida na wikendi tupu zinakera. Tuma mtu asiye tarajiwa katika maisha ya {name} — jirani, mfanyakazi mwenza, mgeni anayegeuka kuwa rafiki.

Mungu, {name} anapitia video za mafanikio ya wengine na anahisi kuwa haonekani. Kupenda na maoni yanadhihaki tupu. Mkatae {name} kutoka kwenye mtego wa kulinganisha na uingize {name} katika jamii halisi, yenye machafuko, inayotoa maisha.

Roho Mtakatifu, {name} amezungukwa na watu kazini lakini anajihisi pekee sana. Akicheka kwa uso, lakini akiumia ndani. Vunja kupitia kwenye uso wa kitaaluma na mpe {name} ujasiri wa kumruhusu mtu ndani.

Baba wa Mbinguni, marafiki wa {name} wote wamehamia katika misimu ambayo {name} hajafikia — ndoa, watoto, kazi. Nafasi inazidi kupanuka na mialiko inachelewa. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba wakati tofauti si thamani ndogo.

Bwana, {name} amepita kwa marafiki wengi wapendwa na mduara unazidi kupungua. Mazishi sasa yanazidi sherehe za kuzaliwa. Asante kwa kila kumbukumbu na uwe rafiki mwaminifu wa {name} katika miaka inayoendelea kupungua.
Baba, {name} yuko katika msimu mgumu na hata watu wanaompenda {name} hawaelewi kikamilifu. Upweke katika umati ni aina kali zaidi. Kuwa yule anayejua kweli, anayekiona kweli, na anayebaki kweli.

Mungu, {name} ni mwanafunzi wa chuo kikuu mbali na nyumbani kwa mara ya kwanza. Chumba cha hosteli kinahisi kigeni na kutamani nyumbani kuna maumivu. Kuwa nyumbani kwa {name} wakati nyumbani iko mbali.

Yesu, {name} anaogopa kuwa dhaifu kwa sababu mara ya mwisho ilimalizika kwa kukataliwa. Kuta zinaonekana salama lakini pia ni gereza. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kuchukua hatari ya kujulikana tena — kuanzia na Wewe.

Roho Mtakatifu, watoto wa {name} wamekua na nyumba sasa inakalia. Kijiji kimekuwa tupu na hivyo ndivyo kusudi la {name} siku nyingine. Fafanua msimu huu. Mwonyeshe {name} kwamba matumizi hayakuondoka na watoto.
Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
verseText: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

templateText: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
verseText: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

templateText: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
verseText: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

templateText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
verseText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

templateText: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
verseText: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

templateText: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
verseText: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

templateText: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
verseText: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

templateText: {name}, Eliya alikimbia kwenye jangwa akijua kwamba alikuwa mtu pekee mwaminifu aliyebaki (1 Wafalme 19:10). Mungu alikutana naye na chakula, pumziko, na ukweli: wengine 7,000 walibaki. Wakati upweke unasema wewe ndiye pekee, unadanganya. Wapi wengine 7,000 wako wanaweza kuwa wanajificha?

{name}, Yesu aliwatuma wanafunzi wawili wawili, kamwe peke yao (Marko 6:7). Aliunda imani kuishi katika ushirika. Ikiwa unatembea peke yako sasa hivi, ni msimu wa kupita, sio kuishi ndani yake. Ni hatua gani moja unaweza kuchukua kuelekea jamii wiki hii?

{name}, Hagar alitupwa kwenye jangwa na mwanawe, akiwa peke yake, hana maji na hana matumaini. Kisha Mungu alifungua macho yake kwa kisima ambacho kilikuwa hapo tangu mwanzo (Mwanzo 21:19). Ni nini ambacho kinaweza kuwa karibu nawe ambacho upweke umekufanya usione?

{name}, hata Yesu, katika kilele cha mateso yake katika Gethsemane, aliwaomba marafiki zake wa karibu wakaye macho pamoja naye (Mathayo 26:38). Kuwa na mahitaji ya watu si udhaifu — ni kibinadamu. Ni nani umekuwa na hofu ya kumuomba kuwa na wewe?
"Roho mara nyingi haijui, lakini iwe ni muumini au la, upweke wake ni kweli kutamani nyumbani kwa Mungu." — Hubert van Zeller
"Upweke si kukosekana kwa kampuni; ni huzuni juu ya kukosekana kwa kujulikana." — Ann Voskamp

{name}, Zaburi 68:6 inasema Mungu huweka wapweke katika familia. Hii inaweza kumaanisha kanisa, kundi dogo, jirani, au rafiki ambaye anakuwa kama jamaa. Ni familia gani Mungu ameweka karibu nawe ambayo hujaikumbatia kikamilifu?

{name}, Mwanzo 2:18 inasema sio vizuri kwa wanadamu kuwa peke yao — Mungu Mwenyewe alitangaza hivyo. Uchungu wako wa kuungana si kasoro katika muundo wako; ni muundo wenyewe. Ni mazungumzo gani ya kweli unaweza kuanza wiki hii?

Baba, imani imevunjika katika uhusiano muhimu zaidi wa {name}. Vipande ni vyenye ncha kali na vimeenea. Ni wewe tu unaweza kufanya vitu vilivyovunjika kuwa vipya. Anza kazi ya polepole, takatifu ya kujenga upya — au mpe {name} ufahamu wa kuachilia.

Yesu, familia ya {name} imevunjika na kila mkusanyiko ni uwanja wa mabomu. Ponya majeraha chini ya majeraha — yale ambayo hakuna anayeongea kuhusu lakini kila mtu anazunguka. Mpe {name} neema ya kusema ukweli katika kimya.

Mungu, mtoto wa {name} ameondoka na umbali unatesa. Kila ujumbe usio na majibu, kila likizo iliyokosa, kila taarifa ya pili — yote yanakera. Endelea kumfuata mtoto wa {name} hata wakati {name} hawezi.

Roho Mtakatifu, {name} yuko katika uhusiano mbaya na anajua lakini kuondoka kunaonekana kuwa haiwezekani. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kuweka mipaka inayoheshimu upendo na heshima binafsi. Kuwepo si kila wakati uaminifu; wakati mwingine kuondoka ni utiifu.
Baba wa Mbinguni, {name} anataka upatanisho lakini mtu mwingine hayuko tayari. Mfundishe {name} kusamehe bila kuhitaji kuungana tena. Acha moyo wa {name} uwe huru hata kama uhusiano haujarejelewa.

Bwana, ndoa ya {name} inaonekana kama mpango wa kibiashara zaidi kuliko hadithi ya upendo. Fufua mwangaza ambao muda na utaratibu umepunguza. Mkumbusha {name} na mwenza wao kwa nini walichagua kila mmoja na ni nani aliwaleta pamoja.

Baba, {name} anaanza upya katika uhusiano — uhusiano mpya unahisi kuwa na hatari baada ya usaliti wa zamani. Msaada {name} kutambua ni nani salama bila kujenga kuta zinazoshikilia kila mtu nje. Fungua moyo wa {name} kwa hekima.

Mungu, mvutano kati ya {name} na mzazi anayekua ni wa miongo mingi. Mifumo ya zamani, majeraha ya zamani, majukumu ya zamani ambayo hayafai tena. Kabla ya wakati kumalizika, legeza moyo wa {name} na leta uponyaji mahali ambapo historia imeleta ugumu tu.
bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
verseText: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

templateText: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
verseText: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

templateText: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
verseText: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

templateText: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
verseText: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

templateText: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
verseText: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

templateText: {name}, Yakobo na Esau walitenganishwa na usaliti, lakini miaka mingi baadaye walikumbatiana na kulia (Mwanzo 33:4). Upatanisho ulichukua miongo na umbali, si mazungumzo moja tu. Ni uhusiano gani uliovunjika unahitaji muda kama mponyo wake?
{name}, baba wa mwana mpotevu alikimbilia kwake alipokuwa bado mbali (Luka 15:20). Hakuangalia kusubiri msamaha au mpango. Itakuwaje kuondoka kwenye porch na kuanza kukimbia kuelekea mtu aliyepotea?

{name}, Paulo na Barnaba walikuwa na tofauti kubwa kiasi kwamba walitengana (Matendo 15:39). Hata watu wa Mungu wakati mwingine hawawezi kutembea pamoja. Si kila uhusiano umeandaliwa kudumu milele. Ni yupi unahitaji kushikilia kwa mikono wazi?
"Kuwa Mkristo inamaanisha kusamehe yasiyoweza kusameheka kwa sababu Mungu amesamehe yasiyoweza kusameheka ndani yako." — C.S. Lewis
"Kina cha upendo wako leo ni kina cha jeraha lako kesho. Na kina cha jeraha lako kesho ni kina cha uponyaji wako baada ya hapo." — Joni Eareckson Tada

{name}, Wakolosai 3:13 inasema usamehe kama Bwana alivyokusamehe. Si nusu, si kwa masharti. Fikiria mtu uliyemsamehe kwa maneno lakini si kwa moyo wako. Ni nini ambacho msamaha kamili ungebadilisha ndani yako?

{name}, Warumi 12:18 inasema "kadri inavyotegemea wewe, ishi kwa amani." Kigezo ni muhimu — baadhi ya uhusiano hayawezi kurekebishwa kwa mikono moja. Je, umefanya sehemu yako? Wapi unaweza kuachilia kile kisichokuwa chako kurekebisha?
Baba, {name} anajiuliza swali gumu zaidi: nipo hapa kwa ajili ya nini? Kimya si ukosefu wako — ni uvumilivu wako. Funua wito wa {name} hatua moja ya uaminifu kwa wakati.
Yesu, {name} anajisikia kukwama katika kazi inayolipa bili lakini inakosa roho. Fungua milango inayolingana na wito. Mpaka wakati huo, msaada {name} kupata maana hata katika mambo ya kawaida.
Mungu, {name} anaanza upya na ukurasa mweupe ni wa kusisimua na wa kutisha. Andika hadithi inayostahili kuishi juu yake. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kuruhusu sura hii iwe tofauti na ya mwisho.

Roho Mtakatifu, {name} ana vipaji ambavyo vinakusanya vumbi. Hofu ya kushindwa, kulinganisha, syndrome ya mlaghai — vyote vinashirikiana kumfanya {name} kuwa mdogo. Nyamazisha mkosoaji wa ndani na fungua kile ulichoweka ndani ya {name}.

Baba wa mbinguni, {name} amestaafu na anajiuliza kama siku bora ziko nyuma. Haziko. Elekeza hekima na uzoefu wa {name} wa miongo katika kusudi la ufalme. Mavuno bado yanahitaji wafanyakazi, bila kujali umri.
Bwana, {name} yuko katika mpito — kati ya misimu, kati ya majukumu, kati ya yule walikuwa na yule wanakuwa. Kati kati ni ya kuchanganya. Kuwa kielelezo cha {name} wakati ramani ni tupu.

Baba, {name} analinganisha maendeleo yao na reel ya mafanikio ya kila mtu na anajisikia nyuma sana. Ondoa kipimo. Mbio za {name} zimeundwa kipekee na wewe na mstari wa kumaliza unaohusika ni uaminifu.

Mungu, {name} anataka kufanya tofauti lakini fursa zinahisi ndogo. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba ufalme wa mbinguni ni kama mbegu ya haradali — mwanzo mdogo unakua kuwa athari kubwa. Bariki vitendo vidogo vya uaminifu.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
verseText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

templateText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
verseText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

templateText: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verseText: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

templateText: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
verseText: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

templateText: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
verseText: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

templateText: {name}, Musa alitumia miaka 40 kama mchungaji kabla ya Mungu kumuita kuongoza Israeli kutoka Misri (Kutoka 3:1-2). Kusubiri hakukuwa kupoteza — ilikuwa maandalizi. Ni ujuzi gani Mungu anajenga katika "miaka yako ya uchungaji" sasa hivi?

{name}, Esther aliwekwa katika ikulu "kwa wakati kama huu" (Esther 4:14). Mahali pako halisi, ujuzi wako maalum, uhusiano wako wa kipekee — hakuna hata moja ni bahati mbaya. Ni "wakati kama huu" upi unaweza kuwa umewekwa kwa ajili yake?

{name}, Yeremia alitolewa wito kabla hajazaliwa, lakini alipinga kwamba alikuwa mdogo sana na hakuwa na sifa (Yeremia 1:5-7). Jibu la Mungu: usiseme wewe ni kijana tu. Ni kisingizio gani umekuwa ukitumia kuchelewesha wito wako?
"Mahali ambapo Mungu anakuita ni mahali ambapo furaha yako ya ndani na njaa kubwa ya dunia inakutana." — Frederick Buechner
"Mungu haita wito walio na sifa. Anafanya walioitwa kuwa na sifa." — Corrie ten Boom

{name}, Waefeso 2:10 inakuita kazi ya Mungu, umeumbwa kwa matendo mema aliyoyaandaa mapema. Si kazi za mtu mwingine — ni zako, haswa. Ni mchanganyiko gani wa uzoefu na shauku unaweza kuashiria kusudi lako lililoandaliwa?

{name}, Wakolosai 3:23 inasema ufanye kwa moyo kama kwa Bwana. Kusudi si kila wakati ufunuo mkubwa — wakati mwingine ni kufanya jambo linalofuata kwa usahihi kwa ubora. Ni kazi gani ya kawaida unaweza kuingiza nia ya milele leo?

Bwana, {name} amekuwa akishikilia kwa nguvu sana. Mfundishe {name} kufungua hizi mikono iliyoshikiliwa na kuachilia kila wasiwasi mikononi mwako yenye uwezo. Wewe ni mtawala juu ya kile {name} hakiwezi kudhibiti.
Baba, {name} anajaribu kuandika hadithi. Leo, msaada {name} arudishe kalamu kwako. Mipango yako ni ya juu, wakati wako ni kamili, na upendo wako hauwezi kushindwa. {name} anajisalimisha.
Yesu, {name} haelewi unachofanya, lakini anachagua kumwamini yule ulivyo. Wakati njia haijulikani, kuwa mwangaza kwa miguu ya {name}. Hatua moja inatosha.
Mungu, {name} amekuwa akijaribu kubeba msimu huu peke yake. Hukuwahi kumuuliza {name} abebe peke yake. Hivi sasa, {name} anaweka matokeo yote, kila hofu, kila 'nini kitatokea' chini ya msalaba.
Roho Mtakatifu, tuliza kelele katika akili ya {name}. Badilisha hitaji la kuelewa kila kitu na imani ya kina kwamba unafanya mambo yote kwa ajili ya mema. {name} anapumzika katika ahadi hiyo.

Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anakiri udanganyifu wa kudhibiti. Unashikilia ulimwengu, kwa hivyo hakika unashikilia maisha ya {name}. Kuza ndani ya {name} kujisalimisha takatifu ambayo inakuja tu kwa kujua tabia yako.
Abba, {name} ameunda mipango mingi ya akiba kutokana na hofu. Samehe kutokuwa na imani hiyo. {name} anachagua leo kutembea kwa imani, si kwa kuona, akimwamini Mwandishi anayeandika hadithi bora.
Bwana Yesu, {name} anachilia ushikaji wa kesho. Wewe ni Alfa na Omega — mwanzo na mwisho tayari viko mikononi mwako. Mfundishe {name} uhuru ulio katika kujisalimisha kabisa kwa uongozi wako.
Bwana, kabla {name} hajachukua hatua katika siku hii, nakutaka uende mbele. Panga kila mazungumzo, kila kazi, kila wakati usiotarajiwa. Siku hii ni yako na {name} anairudisha kwako.
Baba, kadri jua linavyoinuka, inuka katika moyo wa {name}. Jaza {name} kwa kusudi kwa siku hii — si uzalishaji kwa ajili ya uzalishaji, bali utii kwa mwito wako, saa moja kwa wakati.
Yesu, {name} anajitolea asubuhi hii kwako. Linda mawazo ya {name}, ongoza maneno ya {name}, na elekeza hatua za {name}. Chochote kinachokuja leo, acha {name} kukabiliana nacho akiwa na amani yako.
Mungu, asubuhi hii {name} anachagua wewe kwanza. Kabla ya barua pepe, orodha ya kazi, mahitaji — {name} anasimama kusema: Wewe ni Bwana wa siku hii. Tumia {name} kwa utukufu wako.
Roho Mtakatifu, kuwa sauti ya kwanza {name} anayosikia leo. Zuia wasiwasi, haraka, na kulinganisha. Jaza {name} na rehema mpya na ujasiri wa kutembea ndani yao kutoka asubuhi hadi usiku.

Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anajitolea siku hii kama dhabihu ya kuishi. Si kwa sababu {name} anapaswa, bali kwa sababu wewe ni mwenye thamani. Acha kila kazi, bila kujali ni ndogo kiasi gani, iwe kitendo cha ibada.

Abba, {name} hajui kile siku ya leo inachokileta, lakini wewe unajua. Amka matarajio katika moyo wa {name} — si wasiwasi kuhusu kile kinachoweza kwenda vibaya, bali imani katika kile unachopanga nyuma ya pazia.
Bwana, itakase mikono, akili, na kinywa cha {name} asubuhi hii. Acha kila mwingiliano uwe na neema. {name} anataka kuwa harufu ya Kristo katika kila chumba leo.
Baba, kadri siku hii inavyokaribia kumalizika, {name} anasimama kusema asante. Kwa pumzi, kwa neema, kwa njia zisizoonekana ulizomlinda na kumtunza. {name} anashukuru.
Bwana, {name} hakuweza kusema vya kutosha leo, hivyo sikiliza sasa: asante. Kwa rehema ndogo. Kwa masomo magumu. Kwa kutokuwacha upande wa {name}, hata wakati {name} alisahau kutafuta wewe.
Bwana, {name} hakuweza kusema vya kutosha leo, hivyo sikiliza sasa: asante. Kwa rehema ndogo. Kwa masomo magumu. Kwa kutokuwacha upande wa {name}, hata wakati {name} alisahau kutafuta wewe.
Mungu, hata katika siku ngumu, {name} anaweza kupata sababu za kukusifu. Jua la jioni. Neno la huruma. Ukweli kwamba {name} ameweza kuendelea. Wewe ni mwaminifu hata katika nyakati za kawaida.
Roho Mtakatifu, mfundishe {name} nidhamu ya shukrani. Si kama chanya yenye sumu, bali kama nanga inayokumbusha nafsi ya {name}: Mungu amekuwa mwaminifu hapo awali, na atakuwa mwaminifu tena.
Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anahesabu zawadi usiku huu — si hasara. Wewe ni mtoaji wa kila zawadi njema na kamilifu, na moyo wa {name} unajaa shukrani kwa wema wako usiokoma.
Abba, kadri {name} anavyolala usiku huu, acha shukrani iwe neno la mwisho kwenye midomo hii. Umekuwa na ukarimu mkubwa. {name} anapumzika katika ukweli kwamba rehema za kesho tayari zimeandaliwa.
Bwana, {name} anamaliza siku hii kama ilivyopaswa kuanza — kwa sifa. Umehimili, umeweza, ulikuwepo. {name} anakupa utukufu kwa kila pumzi iliyovutwa leo.
Baba, {name} anainua wale wanaoteseka usiku huu — marafiki wanaobeba mizigo ya siri, majirani wanaohisi kusahaulika. Acha Kanisa lako liwe mikono na miguu yako. Tembea kupitia {name} kuwafikia.
Bwana, {name} anasali kwa taifa hili — kwa viongozi kutafuta hekima, kwa jamii kupata uponyaji, kwa haki kuja kama mto. Mahali ambapo kuna mgawanyiko, leta amani yako kupitia {name} na watu wako.
Yesu, {name} anasimama kwa ajili ya waliopotea — wale ambao hawajawahi kusikia jina lako na wale ambao wameondoka. Punguza mioyo migumu, tuma wafanyakazi, na tumia {name} kuwa shahidi.

Mungu, {name} anasali kwa ndoa zinazokabiliwa na shinikizo usiku huu. Leta upatanisho mahali ambapo kuna uchungu na upole mahali ambapo kuna umbali. Acha uhusiano wa {name} uakisi upendo wako wa agano.
Roho Mtakatifu, {name} anainua Kanisa linaloteswa duniani kote. Imarisha wale walio gerezani kwa imani yao. Wape ujasiri wale wanaosifu kwa siri. Acha {name} asichukue uhuru kwa urahisi.
