Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anasali kwa kizazi kijacho — watoto wanaokua katika ulimwengu wa kuchanganya. Inua walimu, linda usafi wao, na wawakaribishe kwako mapema. Tumia {name} kuwa na ushawishi.
Abba, {name} anasali kwa wale wanaopambana na uraibu na aibu. Vunja minyororo ambayo imewafunga kwa miaka. Tuma watu wenye huruma, si hukumu. Acha {name} kuwa sehemu ya jibu.

Bwana, {name} anasimama kwa ajili ya wale wanaohisi kuwa hawapo — wazee, wasio na makazi, waliosahaulika. Fungua macho ya {name} kuona kama unavyoona. Tumia {name} kama chombo cha huruma yako wiki hii.
Bwana, {name} anasimama kwa mamlaka ya Neno Lako dhidi ya kila mpango wa adui. Silaha yoyote iliyoandaliwa dhidi ya {name} haitafanikiwa. Vita ni vyako, na {name} anatumaini katika ushindi wako.
Baba, {name} anavaa silaha zote za Mungu leo — mkanda wa ukweli, koti la haki, viatu vya injili, ngao ya imani, kofia ya wokovu, na upanga wa Roho. {name} amejitayarisha.
Yesu, {name} anakataza roho ya hofu kwa jina lako. Hujamwambia {name} roho ya hofu bali ya nguvu, upendo, na akili timamu. {name} anatembea katika mamlaka hiyo leo.
Mungu, wakati adui anapokiri uongo kuhusu thamani ya {name}, {name} anatangaza ukweli: amechaguliwa, amekombolewa, mpendwa. Mkubwa ni Yeye aliye ndani ya {name} kuliko yule aliye katika ulimwengu.
Roho Mtakatifu, funua kila ngome katika maisha ya {name} — mifumo ya mawazo, tabia, makubaliano na giza. Vunja na ujenge {name} juu ya msingi wa Kristo pekee.
Baba wa mbinguni, {name} anasihi damu ya Yesu juu ya akili, mwili, na roho. Mahali ambapo adui anatafuta kuiba, kuua, na kuharibu, {name} anatangaza kwamba Kristo amekuja kutoa maisha kwa wingi.
Abba, {name} anapinga adui na lazima akimbie. {name} anajisalimisha kwako, anakaribia, na kuchukua kila wazo captive kwa utii wa Kristo. Giza haliwezi kushinda mwangaza wako.
Bwana Yesu, {name} anasimama imara leo. Mashtaka ya adui yamekimwa na kazi yako iliyokamilika msalabani. {name} hakuhukumiwa bali ni mshindi katika jina lililo juu ya majina yote.

Bwana, wewe ni mtakatifu, mtakatifu, mtakatifu. {name} anainua jina lako juu ya majina yote. Si kwa kile unachotoa, bali kwa yule ulivyo — wa milele, asiye badilika, mzuri kupita kiasi. {name} anashangazwa.
Baba, mbingu zinatangaza utukufu Wako na moyo wa {name} unarudia wimbo. Wewe ni mkuu kupita maneno. {name} anakusifu — Muumba, Mshikiliaji, Mwokozi.

Yesu, {name} anasimama kwa heshima. Uliacha kiti cha enzi mbinguni kwa ajili ya zizi, msalaba, na kaburi lililo tupu. Ni upendo gani huu? {name} hana maneno ya kutosha, bali moyo wa shukrani umepiga magoti.
Mungu, {name} anakusifu kwa kila kitu — furaha na vipande vilivyovunjika. Wewe unastahili yote. Acha maisha yote ya {name} yawe wimbo wa sifa kwa jina Lako.
Roho Mtakatifu, jaza {name} kwa ajabu ambayo malaika hawawezi kuchoka. Wewe ni Mungu ambaye alikuwa, yuko, na atakuja. {name} anajiunga na wimbo wa milele: mwanakondoo anastahili.
Baba wa Mbinguni, hakuna kama Wewe. {name} anakutukuza — hekima Yako haiwezi kupimwa, upendo Wako hauishii, nguvu Zako hazina kifani. Wewe pekee ni Mungu na {name} anakusifu.
Abba, {name} hajakuja na orodha leo — bali moyo unaoshiriki sifa. Wewe ni mwema wakati maisha ni mazuri. Wewe ni mwema wakati maisha ni magumu. {name} anatangaza: Wewe ni mwema tu, bila mwisho.
Bwana Yesu, {name} anakuza jina Lako. Kutoka kwenye kina cha baharini hadi kwenye urefu wa mbingu, kila kitu kipo kwa sababu Ulizungumza. {name} ameshindwa na ukuu Wako.

Mfalme wa Mfalme, {name} ananguka kwa magoti. Sio kwa sababu ya wajibu bali kwa sababu ya ufunuo — Wewe ni Simba na Mwanakondoo, mkali na mpole, mwenye haki na mwenye rehema. {name} anasifu kwa roho na kweli.
Mzee wa Siku, {name} anatoa ibada kama manukato ya thamani miguuni Mwako. Wewe ni hazina inayostahili kuuza kila kitu. Furaha ya juu zaidi ya {name} ni kukujua na kukufanya ujulikane.
For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
verseText: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

templateText: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
verseText: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

templateText: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
verseText: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

templateText: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”
verseText: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”

templateText: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
verseText: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

templateText: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.
verseText: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.

templateText: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
verseText: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.

templateText: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away. For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
verseText: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away. For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.

templateText: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
verseText: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.

templateText: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.
verseText: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.

templateText: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
verseText: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

templateText: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.” They answered him, “May Yahweh bless you.”
verseText: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.” They answered him, “May Yahweh bless you.”

templateText: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
verseText: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

templateText: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and Yahweh enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.
verseText: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and Yahweh enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.

templateText: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
verseText: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

templateText: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”
verseText: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”

templateText: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”
verseText: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”

templateText: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verseText: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

templateText: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.
verseText: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

templateText: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
verseText: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

templateText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
verseText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

templateText: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
verseText: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

templateText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
verseText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

templateText: But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
verseText: But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

templateText: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
verseText: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

templateText: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
verseText: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

templateText: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
verseText: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

templateText: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
verseText: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

templateText: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
verseText: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

templateText: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verseText: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

templateText: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
verseText: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

templateText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
verseText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

templateText: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth. For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
verseText: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth. For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

templateText: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
verseText: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

templateText: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
verseText: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

templateText: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
verseText: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

templateText: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
verseText: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

templateText: We love him, because he first loved us.
verseText: We love him, because he first loved us.

templateText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verseText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

templateText: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
verseText: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

templateText: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
verseText: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

templateText: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
verseText: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

templateText: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
verseText: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

templateText: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
verseText: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

templateText: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.
verseText: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

templateText: {name}, Ruth aliacha kila kitu kilichokuwa cha kawaida kumfuata Naomi na Mungu asiyejulikana. Hakuwa na dhamana — bali uaminifu tu. Wakati Mungu anakuomba uingie katika yasiyo ya kawaida, je, utaamini Yeye kama Ruth alivyofanya? Ni kitu gani cha kawaida Mungu anakuomba uachilie?

{name}, Esther alikabili hatari ya maisha yake kuzungumza kwa ajili ya watu wake. Aliwekwa katika ikulu 'kwa wakati kama huu.' Mungu amekuweka pia. Je, ikiwa mahali usikilizwapo unachokaa ndiko hasa ulipostahili kuwa? Je, ujasiri ungeonekana vipi kwa {name} leo?

{name}, Maria alisema 'ndiyo' wakati malaika alikuja — ingawa haikuwa na maana na ingemgharimu sifa yake. Kukabidhi kwake kulibadilisha dunia. Ni nini Mungu anakualika kuingia ambacho kinahisi kikubwa sana, hatari sana, kisicho na uhakika? 'Ndiyo' yako ingekuwa vipi?

{name}, Martha alikuwa na shughuli nyingi akimtumikia wakati Maria aliketi miguuni mwa Yesu. Yesu alisema Maria alichagua jambo bora. Je, uko na shughuli nyingi za kumfanyia Mungu kiasi kwamba umesahau kuwa na Mungu? Je, ingekuwa vipi kwa {name} kuketi tu miguuni mwake leo?

{name}, Deborah aliongoza Israeli kwa hekima na ujasiri wakati wengine walikuwa na wasiwasi. Hakuungoja ruhusa kuingia katika wito wake. Mungu amekupa mamlaka pia. Wapi {name} amekuwa akijizuia? Ni vita gani Mungu anakuomba uongoze leo?

{name}, Daudi alipuuziliwa mbali na familia yake lakini alichaguliwa na Mungu. Alienda kutoka kuwa mchungaji hadi mfalme — si usiku mmoja, bali kupitia mafunzo ya miaka ya jangwa. Kipindi chako kilichofichwa hakijapotea; ni maandalizi. Ni nini Mungu anakuandaa ndani ya {name} hivi sasa?

{name}, Yusufu alisalitiwa, kufungwa, na kusahaulika — lakini Mungu alitumia kila kikwazo kwa mpango mkubwa. Miaka baadaye, aliwaambia ndugu zake: 'Mliweka kwa uovu, lakini Mungu aliweka kwa wema.' Ni maumivu gani katika maisha yako ambayo Mungu anajaribu kubadilisha?

{name}, Musa alikuwa na tatizo la kusema na historia ya uhalifu, lakini Mungu alichagua kumongoza taifa. Alijaribu kujiondoa, lakini Mungu alisema 'nitakuwa pamoja nawe.' Ukosefu wako si kikwazo cha Mungu. Wapi {name} anafanya visingizio badala ya kuamini?

{name}, Nehemia alilia juu ya kuta zilizovunjika, kisha akajitayarisha na kujenga upya. Maumivu yaliweza kumhamasisha kufanya kazi. Aliomba na kupanga kwa kiwango sawa. Ni kitu gani kilichovunjika Mungu amekuweka moyoni mwako kujenga upya? Je, {name} anaweza kuchukua hatua ya kwanza vipi?

{name}, Paulo alitoka katika kuwapiga Wakatoliki hadi kupanda makanisa. Historia yake ilikuwa ya kusisimua, lakini neema pia ilikuwa hivyo. Aliandika: 'Mimi ni kile nilichonacho kwa neema ya Mungu.' Hakuna historia iliyo giza sana kwa ukombozi wa Mungu. Ni kitambulisho gani cha zamani {name} bado anavaa?

{name}, Mwana Mpotevu alitumia kila kitu, lakini aliporejea nyumbani, baba yake alikimbia kwake. Hakuna mazungumzo, hakuna 'nilikuambia' — bali kukumbatia. Ndivyo Mungu anavyoshughulika unaporejea. Haijalishi umepotea kwa mbali kiasi gani, {name}, Baba tayari anakuja kwako.

{name}, Mtu Mwema alivuka kila mipaka ya kijamii kumsaidia mgeni. Yesu hakuuliza 'nani jirani yangu?' — Alikuwa anasema 'nani alikuwa jirani?' Upendo si hisia; ni kitendo. Ni nani Mungu amemweka katika njia ya {name} anahitaji rehema leo?

{name}, Yesu aliondoka kwa 99 ili kumtafuta yule mwana-kondoo mmoja aliyepotea. Haujawahi kupuuziliwa mbali, kusahaulika, au kupotea sana. Angemkuja kwa ajili yako pekee. Acha hilo liingie akilini: Mchungaji aliondoka kila kitu kwa ajili ya {name}. Hii inabadilisha vipi jinsi unavyojiona?

{name}, Katika mfano wa Mpanda Mbegu, mbegu ile ile inanguka kwenye udongo tofauti. Neno halijabadilika — lakini ni aina gani ya udongo moyo wako uko sasa? Uwe na mawe? Uwe na miiba? Umevunjika moyo? Ni nini {name} anaweza kufanya ili kuandaa ardhi laini, inayokubali ukweli wa Mungu?

{name}, katika mfano wa Talanta, bwana alizawadia wale waliowekeza kwa ujasiri — si wale waliokuwa wakificha vipaji vyao kwa hofu. Mungu amekupa {name} kitu cha kipekee. Je, unakiongeza au unakificha? Ni kipaji gani umekalia?

{name}, wakati Yesu aligeuza maji kuwa divai katika Kana, watumishi walilazimika kujaza mitungi kwanza. Walifanya ya kawaida; Yeye alifanya ya kushangaza. Uaminifu katika mambo ya kawaida ni maandalizi ya utukufu wa Mungu. Ni 'mtungi' gani {name} anahitajika kujaza leo?

{name}, mikate mitano ya mvulana na samaki wawili iliwalisha 5,000. Yesu hakuitaji rasilimali zaidi — alihitaji mapenzi. Ni jambo gani dogo mikononi mwako linaonekana kuwa dogo sana? Lipeleke kwa Mungu. Yeye ana utaalamu katika kuongezea kile {name} anachokabidhi.

{name}, Petro alitembea juu ya maji — hadi alipotazama mawimbi. Wakati alihamisha mtazamo wake kutoka kwa Yesu kwenda dhoruba, alizama. Ni dhoruba gani inachukua umakini wako hivi sasa? Weka macho yako kwa Yule anayemiliki upepo. Wapi {name} anatazama?

{name}, Yesu alimuponya mtu aliyekuwa kipofu tangu kuzaliwa. Mafarisayo walimuuliza jinsi; yule mtu alisema 'nilikuwa kipofu lakini sasa naona.' Teolojia ni muhimu, lakini ushuhuda ni wenye nguvu. Ni nini Mungu amefanya katika maisha yako ambacho unaweza kusema kwa urahisi: Alifanya hili?

{name}, wakati Yesu alimfufua Lazaro, Martha alisema 'laiti ungekuwa hapa.' Yesu alijibu: 'Mimi ni ufufuo.' Hakuwa na kuchelewa — alikuwa anaredefine kile kinachowezekana. Ni hali gani {name} amepaza sauti kwamba Mungu anaweza kuwa karibu kumfufua?

{name}, Zaburi ya 13 inaanza na 'Ni muda gani, Ee Bwana?' Daudi hakujiweka kama kila kitu kiko sawa. Alileta maumivu yake ya kweli kwa Mungu. Uwazi mbele ya Mungu si ukosefu wa imani — ni aina ya kina zaidi ya uaminifu. Ni nini umekuwa na hofu kusema kwa sauti kwa Mungu?

{name}, katika Zaburi 88 hakuna ufumbuzi — inaishia gizani. Hata hivyo, mwandishi wa zaburi alielekeza maumivu yake kwa Mungu. Wakati mwingine imani si kuhisi bora; ni kuonekana kwa uaminifu. Je, {name} anaweza kuleta maumivu yasiyokuwa na ufumbuzi kwa Mungu bila kutafuta jibu usiku huu?

{name}, Zaburi 42 inasema 'Maji ya kina yanaita maji ya kina.' Mwandishi wa zaburi alikuwa akizama katika huzuni lakini bado alihitaji Mungu. Maumivu yako na imani yako vinaweza kuwepo pamoja. Ni sawa kuwa na majeraha na kuamini. Ni kilio kipi cha ndani cha moyo wa {name} usiku huu?

{name}, katika Zaburi 22 Daudi alilia 'Mungu wangu, kwa nini umeniacha?' — maneno yale yale Yesu alisema msalabani. Mungu anaelewa kuachwa kutoka ndani. Yuko mbali na maumivu yako; aliingia ndani yake. Ni wapi {name} anapojisikia ameachwa?

{name}, Zaburi 77 inauliza 'Je, Mungu amesahau kuwa na huruma?' Kisha Asafu anageuka: 'Nitakumbuka matendo Yako.' Wakati hisia zinasema Mungu hayupo, kumbukumbu inasema Amekuwa mwaminifu. Ni uaminifu upi wa zamani {name} anaweza kushikilia katika msimu huu wa giza?
Usiogope kamwe kuamini siku zijazo zisizojulikana kwa Mungu anayejulikana. — Corrie ten Boom
Siri ni Kristo ndani yangu, si mimi katika hali tofauti. — Elisabeth Elliot
Ikiwa unawahukumu watu, huna muda wa kuwaonyesha upendo. — Mama Teresa
Wakati maisha yanakushinda, usisahau Mungu anashughulikia yote kwa neema Yake. — Joni Eareckson Tada
Furaha si ukosefu wa mateso. Ni uwepo wa Mungu. — Ann Voskamp
Mungu si adui wa wenye dhambi — Yeye ni adui wa dhambi. — Howard Thurman
Imani ni kuchukua hatua ya kwanza hata wakati huoni ngazi yote. — Martin Luther King Jr.
Huwezi kuchagua vita ambavyo Mungu anakuweka ndani yake, lakini unaweza kuchagua ikiwa unapigana kwa imani au hofu. — Priscilla Shirer
Ikiwa unataka maisha yaliyobadilika, unahitaji zaidi ya akili iliyobadilika. Unahitaji moyo uliobadilika. — Tony Evans
Utakatifu si kuhusu kupata sawa; ni kuhusu kumilikiwa na Yule aliye sawa. — Jackie Hill Perry
Maisha yanayompendeza Mungu si maisha yanayoishi kwa juhudi zetu; ni maisha yanayoishi kwa nguvu za Mungu. — Watchman Nee
Mungu yuko tayari kuchukua jukumu kamili kwa maisha yaliyojitoa kikamilifu kwake. — Andrew Murray
Msalaba ni zawadi ya Mungu kwa dunia iliyovunjwa na dhambi. Ni tiba — si adhabu. — Sadhu Sundar Singh
Umetuumba kwa ajili Yako, Ee Bwana, na mioyo yetu haipumziki mpaka ipumzike ndani Yako. — Augustine wa Hippo
Wema ni nguvu zaidi kuliko uovu. Upendo ni nguvu zaidi kuliko chuki. Mwanga ni nguvu zaidi kuliko giza. Maisha ni nguvu zaidi kuliko kifo. — Desmond Tutu
Mungu hawezi kutupa amani na furaha mbali na Yeye mwenyewe kwa sababu hakuna kitu kama hicho. — C.S. Lewis
Kile kinachokuja akilini mwetu tunapofikiria Mungu ndicho kitu muhimu zaidi kuhusu sisi. — A.W. Tozer
Neema ya bei nafuu ni neema bila wanafunzi, neema bila msalaba. Neema ya gharama kubwa ni injili ambayo inapaswa kutafutwa tena na tena. — Dietrich Bonhoeffer
Mtihani halisi wa kuwa katika uwepo wa Mungu ni kwamba unajisahau kabisa na unajishughulisha naye. — Oswald Chambers
Mungu ni mzuri sana kuwa mbaya na mwenye hekima sana kuwa na makosa. Wakati huwezi kufuatilia mkono Wake, amini moyo Wake. — Charles Spurgeon
Injili ni hii: sisi ni wenye dhambi na kasoro zaidi kuliko tulivyothubutu kuamini, lakini tunapendwa na kukubaliwa zaidi kuliko tulivyothubutu kutumaini. — Tim Keller
Kukimbia ni adui mkubwa wa maisha ya kiroho. Lazima uondoe bila huruma kukimbia katika maisha yako. — John Mark Comer
Mungu hakuahidi hatutavunjika. Aliahidi atakuwa karibu nasi tunapovunjika. — Lysa TerKeurst
Upendo unafanya. Haifikirii tu au kupanga. Upendo unaonekana na unahusika. — Bob Goff
Mungu haita watu waliojiandaa. Anawapa vifaa walioitwa. Tembea mbele hata wakati unajisikia hujaandaliwa. — Jennie Allen

{name}, Waefeso 2:10 inasema wewe ni kazi ya Mungu. Si rasimu, si makosa — ni kazi ya sanaa. Ikiwa ungeamini kweli hilo, ungeacha kuomba msamaha kwa ajili ya nini? Nini kingebadilika kuhusu jinsi {name} anavyopita kesho?

{name}, ulimwengu unasema wewe ni kile unachofanya, unachoshinda, kile wengine wanachofikiria kuhusu wewe. Lakini Mungu anasema wewe ni mtoto Wake. Ni sauti ipi imekuwa kubwa zaidi wiki hii? Wapi {name} anatafuta utambulisho nje ya Kristo?

{name}, Wakolosai 3:3 inasema maisha yako yamefichwa na Kristo ndani ya Mungu. Haujafafanuliwa na wakati wako mbaya zaidi au mafanikio yako bora. Ningewezaje {name} kuishi tofauti ikiwa usalama huu ungekuwa msingi wa kweli?

{name}, kabla hujafanya chochote, Mungu alikuchagua. Waefeso 1:4 inasema Alikuchagua kabla ya msingi wa ulimwengu. Thamani yako haipatikani — inatangazwa. Ni uongo gani kuhusu thamani yako {name} amekuwa akiamini?

{name}, 2 Wakorintho 5:17 inasema ikiwa mtu yuko ndani ya Kristo, yeye ni kiumbe kipya. Ya zamani imepita. Lakini je, bado unaishi kana kwamba utambulisho wa zamani una mamlaka? Ni sehemu gani ya 'zamani {name}' unayoendelea kubeba?

{name}, Yesu alisema 'samehe kama nilivyowasamehe ninyi.' Je, kuna mtu umesema umemsamehe lakini bado unarudia maumivu? Kutokumsamehe ni gereza lenye mlango unaofunguka kutoka ndani. Ni nani {name} anayeendelea kumshikilia deni?

{name}, Mathayo 18 inaelezea hadithi ya mtumwa aliyesamehewa deni kubwa ambaye kisha alimshika mtu kwa deni dogo. Je, umepokea msamaha wa Mungu wa kupita kiasi lakini bado unahangaika kuupatia? Uhuru ungeonekana vipi kwa {name}?

{name}, wakati mwingine mtu mgumu zaidi kusamehe ni wewe mwenyewe. Warumi 8:1 inasema hakuna hukumu kwa wale walio ndani ya Kristo. Je, unaishi chini ya hukumu ambayo Mungu tayari ameondoa? Ni hatia gani {name} anabeba ambayo Yesu tayari alichukua?

{name}, msamaha hauimaanishi kile kilichotokea kilikuwa sawa. Inamaanisha unakataa kuruhusu iwe na nguvu juu yako tena. Waefeso 4:32 inasema 'kuwa wema, mkisameheana.' Hatua moja kuelekea msamaha ingekuwa vipi kwa {name} wiki hii?

{name}, katika Marko 11:25 Yesu anahusisha msamaha na maombi: 'Wakati unasimama ukiomba, ikiwa unashikilia chochote dhidi ya mtu yeyote, samehe.' Uchungu unakwamisha ukaribu na Mungu. Je, kuna kutokumsamehe kunakisimamisha kati ya {name} na Baba?
{name}, Yesu alisema ni heri kutoa kuliko kupokea. Lakini ukarimu si kuhusu pesa tu — ni kuhusu muda, umakini, na neema. Wapi {name} anakuwa mkarimu, na wapi hofu inakufanya ushindwe?

{name}, Malaki 3:10 inasema 'nijaribu katika hili — ona kama sitafungua milango ya mbinguni.' Mungu anakualika kujaribu ukarimu wake. Je, unashikilia rasilimali zako kwa mikono wazi au kwa fist zilizoshikilia? Ukarimu wa kipekee ungeonekana vipi kwa {name}?

{name}, mjane alitoa sarafu mbili ndogo — yote aliyokuwa nayo. Yesu alisema alitoa zaidi ya matajiri. Ukarimu haupimwi kwa kiasi bali kwa dhabihu. Je, ni kitendo gani kidogo cha kutoa ambacho Mungu anakuongoza {name} kufanya leo?

{name}, 2 Wakorintho 9:7 inasema Mungu anapenda mtoaji mwenye furaha. Ukarimu unaotokana na hatia si ukarimu — ni wajibu. Je, kutoa kwako kunatokana na furaha au kulazimishwa? Ukarimu wa furaha ungekuwa vipi kwa {name}?

{name}, Mithali 11:25 inasema mtu mkarimu atafanikiwa. Lakini mafanikio si kila wakati ya kifedha — wakati mwingine ni amani, kusudi, na uhusiano wa kina. Wapi {name} anashikilia wakati Mungu anataka imani ya mikono wazi?

{name}, Yesu alisema 'Njooni kwangu, nyote mliokumbwa na uchovu na mizigo, nami nitawapa pumziko.' Je, unakimbia bila nguvu na kuita kuwa ni nguvu? Pumziko halisi — si usingizi tu, bali pumziko la roho — lingeonekana vipi kwa {name}?

{name}, Mungu alipumzika siku ya saba — si kwa sababu alikuwa mchovu, bali kwa sababu alikuwa amemaliza. Thamani yako haihusiani na matokeo yako. Sabato si uvivu; ni imani. Ni lini {name} alipumzika kweli bila hatia?

{name}, Zaburi 46:10 inasema 'Nyamaza na ujue ya kwamba mimi ni Mungu.' Nyamaza si kutokufanya chochote — ni kujisalimisha kwa makusudi. Katika kimya, Mungu anazungumza kwa sauti kubwa. Ni kelele gani katika maisha ya {name} inayozuia sauti Yake?

{name}, kuna tofauti kati ya kupumzika ndani ya Mungu na kupumzika mbali na Mungu. Moja inakujaza; nyingine inakupunguza. Je, unajitahidi kupata kile ambacho tayari kimepewa? Utaonekana vipi kwa {name} kusitisha kufanya na kuanza kupokea?

{name}, Isaya 30:15 inasema 'katika kimya na imani kuna nguvu yako.' Ulimwengu unazawadia harakati, lakini Mungu anazawadia imani. Je, unachanganya shughuli na uaminifu? Wapi {name} anahitaji kubadilisha juhudi na kimya?

Yahweh Sabaoth, {name} anasimama katika pengo kama mwombezi asubuhi hii. Kama Abrahamu alivyomlilia Sodoma, mpe {name} ujasiri wa kupigania waliopotea. Acha chesed Yako — upendo wa agano — ipite kupitia maombi ya {name} kutikisa mbingu.

Baba, kama Paulo alivyowaandikia Wefeso, {name} anavaa silaha kamili za Mungu leo. Mvike {name} ukweli, koti la haki, ngao ya imani. Mapambano yetu si dhidi ya mwili na damu. Mpe nguvu {name} kwa ajili ya vita vya kiroho vilivyoko mbele.

Roho Mtakatifu, takasa {name} — hagiasmos, weka kando kwa ajili ya malengo Yako. Si kwa juhudi bali kwa kujisalimisha. Kama moto wa mfinyanzi unavyosafisha chuma, choma ndani ya {name} kile kisichomwakilisha Kristo. Fanya utakatifu usiwe mzigo bali furaha.

El Shaddai, Wewe ambaye ni Mungu Mwenye Nguvu na Mtoaji wa Kila Kitu, {name} anapumzika katika uaminifu Wako wa agano usiku huu. Kile ulichomwahidi Abrahamu, kilichothibitishwa kupitia Isaka, na kutimizwa katika Kristo — utakamilisha katika maisha ya {name}. Hesed Yako inadumu milele.

Bwana wa mavuno, {name} anaomba kwa ajili ya kuendeleza ufalme Wako. Kama Isaya alivyotazama kiti chako cha enzi na kusema 'Hapa nipo, nitume,' chochea tayari hiyo mapenzi takatifu ndani ya {name}. Acha missio Dei ipite kupitia siku za kawaida za {name}.

Abba Baba, {name} anaingia katika chumba chako cha enzi kwa parresia — ujasiri mkubwa — kupitia damu ya Yesu. Kama Waebrania 4:16 inavyosema, {name} anakaribia kupokea rehema na kupata neema kwa ajili ya jaribu hili la sasa. Wewe ni Kuhani Mkuu wetu ambaye anajua udhaifu wetu.

Yesu, Wewe uliyevunja kifo kwa kifo, {name} anatangaza ushindi juu ya falme na nguvu zinazopinga watu Wako. Kama Wakolosai 2:15 inavyotangaza, ulizivunja silaha katika msalaba. Acha {name} simame imara katika kazi hiyo iliyokamilika usiku huu.

Mungu wa faraja yote, kama {name} anavyomwombea walio na majeraha ya moyo, acha paraklesis ya 2 Wakorintho 1:3-4 ipite kupitia maombi haya. Faraja {name} aliyopokea katika mateso, acha izidishe kwa wale wanaolia. Ongeza hii maombi, Bwana.

Bwana, fanya theosis Yako ndani ya {name} — si kwamba tu tufanyike miungu, bali kwamba tuwe washiriki wa asili ya kimungu kama 2 Petro 1:4 inavyohakikishia. Badilisha {name} kutoka utukufu hadi utukufu. Acha asili ya zamani ife kila siku na kiumbe kipya kijitokeze.

Mungu Mwaminifu, berith Yako — agano Lako — haliwezi kuvunjika. Kama Yeremia 31:33 inavyosema, unaandika sheria Yako katika mioyo, si kwenye tabla. {name} anaamini kwamba agano hili jipya, lililotiwa muhuri kwa damu ya Kristo, linamfanya {name} kuwa salama. Hakuna kinachoweza kututenganisha na upendo Wako.

Mfalme Yesu, punguza ufalme Wako kupitia {name} leo. Kama Daniel alivyoyaona jiwe lisilokatwa na mikono ya kibinadamu lilijaza dunia yote, acha {name} afanye kazi kwa matumaini ya eskatolojia — akijua kwamba kila kitendo cha uaminifu kinachochea siku ya kurudi Kwako.

Roho wa Mungu aliye hai, {name} anaomba kwa ajili ya ufahamu — diakrisis — kutofautisha ukweli na udanganyifu katika saa hii. Linda akili ya {name} kama Waefeso 4:7 inavyohakikishia, kwa amani inayozidi kueleweka. Keep {name} rooted in sound doctrine.

Baba, {name} anainua mataifa mbele Yako usiku huu. Kama Zaburi 2 inavyosema, Unacheka kwa wale wanaopanga dhidi Yako. Mfalme Wako aliyewekwa mafuta anatawala. Mpe {name} moyo kwa ajili ya wasiofikiwa — ethne — na ujasiri wa kuomba kwa ajili ya Agano Kuu.

Bwana Yesu, mwandishi na mkamilishaji wa imani, endelea kazi Yako ya kutakasa ndani ya {name}. Kama Mfinyanzi anavyoshape udongo kwenye gurudumu, {name} anajisalimisha kwa shinikizo la mikono Yako. Kile kinachohisi kama kuvunjika kweli kinaunda. Kamilisha kile ulichokianza.

Jehovah Jireh, Wewe uliyepeana mwanakondoo kwa Abrahamu kwenye Moriah, {name} anaamini katika utoaji Wako. Aqedah ilionyesha Kalvari — Baba akimtoa Mwanaye pekee. {name} anapumzika katika utoaji ulio kamilika wa msalaba kwa kila hitaji usiku huu.

Mungu wa shema, {name} anatangaza: Sikiliza, Ee Israeli, Bwana Mungu wetu, Bwana ni mmoja. Kwa moyo wote, nafsi, na nguvu, {name} anakupenda. Acha kukiri hii ya kale isiwe tu kurudiarudia bali iwe kitu cha moto katika uwepo wa {name} leo.

Mungu Mwenye Nguvu, kama {name} anavyopambana na mshtaki, kumbusha {name} kuhusu Zakaria 3 — ambapo Shetani alimshtaki Yoshua kuhani mkuu lakini Wewe ulisema 'Bwana akukemee.' {name} anasimama akiwa amevaa haki ya Kristo, si yetu wenyewe. Nyamaza kila shtaka.

Bwana wa majeshi, mobilize {name} kwa ajili ya kazi ya ufalme iliyo mbele yetu. Kama Nehemia alivyorejesha kuta katikati ya upinzani, mpe {name} spade katika mkono mmoja na upanga katika mwingine. Jenga na pigana kwa wakati mmoja, kwa sababu kazi ni kubwa na wafanyakazi ni wachache.

Mungu, {name} anakaa katika mvutano wa 'tayari na bado.' Ufalme Wako umekuja katika Kristo, lakini bado tunasubiri ukamilifu wake. Mfundishe {name} kuishi kwa kutoridhika takatifu — akitamani shalom huku akitumikia kwa uaminifu katika uvunjifu. Maranatha.

For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
verseText: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

templateText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verseText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

templateText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
verseText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

templateText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
verseText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

templateText: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
verseText: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

templateText: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.
verseText: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.

templateText: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verseText: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

templateText: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance. Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
verseText: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance. Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

templateText: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
verseText: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

templateText: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you. But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
verseText: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you. But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

templateText: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
verseText: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

templateText: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verseText: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

templateText: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.
verseText: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.

templateText: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin. Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
verseText: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin. Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

templateText: {name}, neno la Kiebrania 'kapar' (kufidia) linamaanisha 'kufunika.' Katika Yom Kippur, kiti cha rehema kilipakwa damu — kivuli cha Kristo, kapporeth wetu wa kweli (Warumi 3:25). Kufunika kwa Agano la Kale ilikuwa ya muda; utimizo wa Agano Jipya ni wa milele. {name}, hujafunikwa tu — umeoshwa.

{name}, Zaburi 22 ni kazi ya sanaa ya ki-chiastic. Inaanza na 'Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, kwa nini umeniacha?' na kumaliza na 'Amefanya' — sawa na Kiebrania tetelestai, 'Imekamilika.' Yesu alirejelea vitabu vyote viwili kutoka msalabani. Kati ya zaburi? 'Wewe ni mtakatifu.' {name}, mateso na utawala hukutana msalabani.

{name}, wakati Musa alipogonga mwamba Meribah, maji yalitoka kwa wingi kwa Israeli. Paulo anaonyesha mfano huu: 'Mwamba huo ulikuwa Kristo' (1 Kor 10:4). Kristo aligongwa mara moja Calvary; maji ya uzima sasa yanatiririka bure. {name}, unakunywa kutoka kwa Mwamba ulioharibiwa kwa ajili yako.

Neno la Kigiriki 'metamorphoo' katika Warumi 12:2 ni neno lilelile lililotumika kwa ajili ya mabadiliko ya Kristo. {name}, mabadiliko ambayo Paulo anataka si ya uso tu — ni mabadiliko ya ndani. Utukufu ulioangaza kutoka kwa Yesu juu ya mlima ni utukufu uleule unaoundwa ndani ya {name} kupitia upya wa akili yako.

{name}, Melkizedeki anaonekana bila ukoo katika Mwanzo 14 — hana baba, hana mama, hana mwanzo wala mwisho. Waebrania 7 inaonyesha kwa nini: alikuwa mfano wa Kristo, ambaye ukuhani wake ni wa milele, si wa Kihubiri. {name}, mpatanishi wako anahudumu katika mpangilio usioharibiwa ambao unatangulia na kuzidi sheria.

{name}, pazia la hema lilikuwa limefanywa kwa kerubi — walinzi wale wale waliokuwa wamewekwa kwenye lango la Edeni baada ya kuanguka. Wakati Kristo alikufa, pazia hilo lilipasuka kutoka juu hadi chini. Njia ya kurudi katika uwepo wa Mungu, iliyozuiliwa tangu Mwanzo 3, ilifunguliwa. {name}, sasa unaingia katika bustani ya Edeni iliyoimarishwa.

Neno la Kiebrania 'shalom' linamaanisha zaidi ya amani, {name}. Linabeba ukamilifu, kukamilika, hakuna kilichovunjika na hakuna kilichokosekana. Wakati Yesu alisema 'Amani yangu nawapa ninyi' (Yohana 14:27), Alitoa ukamilifu wa shalom — urejeleaji wa yote ambayo dhambi ilivunja. {name}, shalom hii ni urithi wako.

{name}, katika Kutoka 12, damu ya mwanakondoo wa Pasaka kwenye miongoni mwa milango ilifanya umbo la msalaba — lintel ya juu, nguzo mbili za upande. Israeli ilikombolewa kupitia mlango wa msalaba karne nyingi kabla ya Calvary. Kila Seder ilitazamia mbele kwa Mwanakondoo wa Mungu. {name}, hadithi yote inainama kuelekea msalaba.

{name}, Kigiriki 'anakainosis' (upya) katika Tito 3:5 inashiriki mzizi wake na 'kainos' — si tu kurekebishwa bali kufanywa kuwa mpya kwa ubora. Kuzaliwa upya si Mungu kurekebisha {name} ya zamani; ni Mungu kuumba {name} mpya. Hii si ukarabati. Hii ni ufufuo.

Zaburi 51 inafuata muundo wa ki-chiastic, {name}: dhambi-kukiri kwenye mipaka, na katikati (sura ya 10) — 'Uumbe ndani yangu moyo safi.' Kiebrania 'bara' inatumika tu kwa matendo ya uumbaji ya Mungu (Mwanzo 1:1). Daudi hakuomba kuboreshwa bali uumbaji wa kimungu. {name}, ni Mungu pekee anayeweza kuumba usafi ex nihilo.

Bwana, {name} amekasirika na anajitahidi kushikilia vema. Ulibadilisha meza katika hekalu — Unajua moto wa hasira ya haki. Lakini msaada {name} kutambua mpaka kati ya hasira takatifu na hasira ya dhambi. Usiruhusu jua kuzama juu ya hasira ya {name} usiku wa leo.

Baba, {name} anakiri uchungu ulioingia mizizi. Mtu amemjeruhi {name} kwa kina na msamaha unahisi kuwa hauwezekani. Lakini Umetusamehe wakati tulipokuwa bado wenye dhambi. Mimina neema Yako ili {name} aweze kumwachilia mtu huyu Kwako. Vunja mnyororo wa chuki.

Yesu, {name} anabeba hasira inayoshindwa kuisha — kazini, nyumbani, kila upande. Fundisha {name} kuwa mwepesi kusikiliza, polepole kusema, na polepole kukasirika, kama vile Yakobo anavyofundisha. Badilisha hasira hii fupi na uvumilivu Wako wa muda mrefu.

Mungu, {name} amekosewa na tamaa ya kulipiza kisasi inawaka moto. Lakini Umesema 'Kisasi ni changu, nitarejesha.' Msaada {name} kuamini haki Yako na kuweka chini haja ya kulipiza kisasi. {name} anachagua kumkabidhi hili Kwako, hakimu mwenye haki.

Bwana, hasira {name} anayo kuelekea hali hii ni nzito na inachosha. Inachukua usingizi wa {name} na kuharibu mawazo ya {name}. Mpe pumziko moyo huu uchovu. Fundisha kwamba kushikilia hasira ni kama kunywa sumu. Ponya jeraha lililoko chini ya hasira.

Baba, {name} anaomba uvumilivu ambao tu Roho Wako huzalisha. Pale hasira imeharibu uhusiano, leta uponyaji. Pale maneno makali yamezungumzwa, leta toba. Mpe {name} jibu la upole linaloondoa hasira, kama vile Mithali inavyofundisha.

Roho Mtakatifu, chunguza moyo wa {name} na ufunue mzizi wa hasira hii. Je, ni matarajio yasiyokamilika? Kiburi? Hofu? Haki? Lolote lililo chanzo, lete katika mwanga. {name} hataki kutawaliwa na hasira. Mwachilie {name} kutoka kwa mzunguko wa hasira na majuto.

Yesu, Mkuu wa Amani, {name} amechoka na hasira zinazoshuka na aibu inayofuatia. Uumbe ndani ya {name} moyo safi na roho tulivu. Wakati uchokozi unakuja, acha {name} asimame kabla ya kujibu. Badilisha msukumo wa kulipuka na nidhamu ya kuomba kwanza.

Mungu, {name} anachagua msamaha leo — si kwa sababu kosa lilikuwa dogo, bali kwa sababu msamaha Wako kuelekea {name} ulikuwa mkubwa kupita kiasi. Punguza moyo huu mgumu. Acha {name} aende huru kutoka kwa chuki hata wakati jeraha bado linauma. Neema Yako inatosha.

Baba, {name} amekasirika na hali ambazo zinaonekana kuwa zisizo za haki. Dunia imevunjika na {name} anahisi maumivu ya mambo kuwa sawa. Elekeza hasira hii katika kusudi takatifu — si uharibifu. Acha hasira ya haki iwe chanzo cha maombi, huduma, na matumaini katika maisha ya {name}.
“Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath, and don’t give place to the devil.
verseText: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath, and don’t give place to the devil.

templateText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

templateText: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
verseText: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

templateText: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
verseText: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

templateText: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
verseText: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

templateText: Jehovah Rapha, Mungu anayeponya, {name} anakuleta mwili huu uliovunjika mbele Yako. Uchunguzi ni mzito na njia inayokuja haijulikani. Lakini Wewe uliyemuumba kila seli unajua jinsi ya kurekebisha. {name} anaamini mikono Yako — mikono hiyo hiyo iliyoigusa wenye ukoma na kufungua macho ya vipofu.

Baba, {name} anasubiri majibu — matokeo ya mtihani, simu za daktari, skani inayofuata. Kusubiri ni aina yake ya mateso. Shikilia {name} imara katika nafasi hii ya katikati. Iwe habari ni ngumu au yenye matumaini, {name} anachagua kuamini kwamba Wewe ni mtawala juu ya kila seli.

Baba, {name} amechoka kutokana na maumivu ya muda mrefu ambayo hayapungui kamwe. Siku nyingine mwili unajisikia kama gereza. Hata hivyo, Paulo alikuwa na mwiba katika mwili na alisikia 'Neema Yangu inatosha.' Acha {name} apate kutosha hiyo leo — nguvu iliyokamilika katika udhaifu.

Mungu, {name} anainua mpendwa ambaye ni mgonjwa. Ni maumivu kuangalia mtu unayempenda akiteseka. Mpe hekima madaktari, ujuzi wauguzi, na amani isiyo ya kawaida kwa familia. Mzungushe mpendwa wa {name} na uwepo Wako wa uponyaji usiku huu.

Bwana Yesu, {name} anashughulika na afya ya akili — ukungu wa unyogovu, uzito wa wasiwasi, vita ambavyo hakuna anayeona. Unajali akili kama vile unavyohusika na roho. Mwongoze {name} kwa msaada unaohitajika na uondoe aibu yoyote. Kuponya akili ni kazi takatifu.

Baba wa mbinguni, mwili wa {name} umefanywa kwa hofu na ajabu, hata wakati haujisikii hivyo. Katika misimu ya ugonjwa, kumbusha {name} kwamba utambulisho haupatikani katika afya bali ndani Yako. Nafasi ya nje inaharibika, lakini nafsi ya ndani inarejeshwa siku kwa siku.

Mungu, {name} amechoka — kimwili, kihisia, kiroho. Mwili unakata na roho inashindwa. Kama Eliya alipoanguka chini ya mti wa mkaratusi na Wewe kutuma malaika na mkate na maji, mtunzie {name} sasa. Mpe pumziko, lishe, na nguvu ya kuchukua hatua inayofuata.

Bwana, {name} anaomba ujasiri wa kuutunza mwili huu vizuri — kupumzika wakati wa kupumzika kunahitajika, kutafuta msaada bila aibu, kukubali mipaka bila kupoteza matumaini. Unakaa ndani ya {name} kama hekalu. Msaada {name} kuheshimu mwili huu, ingawa umevunjika, kama ardhi takatifu.

Baba, matibabu ni magumu na athari za upande hazina mwisho. {name} anajisikia kama kukata tamaa. Lakini Wewe unawasaidia wanyonge na kuimarisha wanyonge. Beba {name} kupitia bonde hili. Upande wa pili, na iwe na ushuhuda wa uaminifu Wako. {name} anashikilia kwako.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verseText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

templateText: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
verseText: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

templateText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verseText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

templateText: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable. He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
verseText: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable. He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

templateText: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord; and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
verseText: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord; and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

templateText: Adonai, {name} anaomba kama makuhani wa Kileviti walivyofanya zamani — wakiwa katikati ya walio hai na wafu. Kama Haruni alivyokimbia na thabiti katika janga, acha {name} aombe kwa dharura. Maombi ya wenye haki yanaweza kufanya mambo mengi. Hamasi mbinguni kwa niaba ya walio na majeraha.
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
verseText: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

templateText: Bwana, {name} anakiri kwamba hasira dhidi Yako imefichwa chini ya uso. {name} ana hasira kuhusu kile ulichokubali. Lakini kama Ayubu, leta hii kwa uaminifu mbele Yako badala ya kugeuka. Mkutanishe {name} katika dhoruba na urejeshe kile ambacho kuuliza hakiwezi.
Mara nyingi tunajaribu kubadilisha hali ili ziweze kutufaa, badala ya kuacha zitupe sisi, ambavyo ndivyo zinavyokusudiwa kufanya. — Elisabeth Elliot
Wasiwasi hauondoi kesho ya huzuni yake. Unatoa leo nguvu zake. — Corrie ten Boom
Tunapokuwa na maombi, Mungu anasikia zaidi ya tunavyosema, anajibu zaidi ya tunavyouliza, anatoa zaidi ya tunavyofikiria, kwa wakati wake mwenyewe na kwa njia yake mwenyewe. — Beth Moore
Wakati maisha ni mazito na magumu kubeba, nenda peke yako. Ingia katika kimya. Piga magoti katika maombi. Usijiulize maswali: Subiri tumaini litokee. — Joni Eareckson Tada
Mungu si tu mahali fulani. Yuko kila mahali. Na Yuko si tu katika kila mahali; Yuko kwa upendo, kwa kusudi. — Jackie Hill Perry

Kiini cha matumaini ni kwamba hakichukui hesabu ya sasa, lakini ni chanzo cha msukumo, nguvu na matumaini ambapo wengine wamekata tamaa; inamuwezesha mtu kushikilia kichwa chake juu, kudai siku zijazo kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na si kuiacha kwa adui yake. — Dietrich Bonhoeffer
Bwana huenda asije wakati unataka, lakini Yuko kila wakati kwa wakati sahihi. — Watchman Nee
Umetuumba kwa ajili Yako, Ee Bwana, na mioyo yetu haijapata pumziko hadi ipumzike ndani Yako. — Augustine
Siri ya furaha haipatikani katika kutafuta zaidi, bali katika kuendeleza uwezo wa kufurahia kidogo. — Ndugu Andrew
Fanya sehemu yako ndogo ya wema ulipo; ni hizo sehemu ndogo za wema zilizounganishwa ambazo zinashinda dunia. — Desmond Tutu
Kuna mambo bora zaidi, bora zaidi mbele kuliko yale tunayoyaacha nyuma. — C.S. Lewis
Kile kinachokuja akilini mwetu tunapofikiria kuhusu Mungu ndicho kitu muhimu zaidi kuhusu sisi. — A.W. Tozer
Mungu ni mzuri kupita kiasi ili kuwa mbaya na Yeye ni mwenye hekima kupita kiasi ili kukosea. Na wakati hatuwezi kufuatilia mkono Wake, tunapaswa kuamini moyo Wake. — Charles Spurgeon
Biblia si mwisho wa Mungu kuzungumza; ni msingi wa mazungumzo yanayoendelea. — Oswald Chambers
Upendo wa jirani zetu ndiyo mlango pekee wa kutoka katika gereza la nafsi. — George MacDonald

Injili ni hii: Sisi ni wenye dhambi na kasoro zaidi ndani yetu kuliko tulivyowahi kuamini, lakini wakati huo huo, tunapendwa na kukubaliwa zaidi katika Yesu Kristo kuliko tulivyowahi kutarajia. — Tim Keller
Ufufuo ni ufunuo kwamba Mungu hashindwi na nguvu za uharibifu. Upendo ni nguvu zaidi kuliko kifo. — N.T. Wright
Mungu hakuwahi kusema kwamba safari itakuwa rahisi, lakini alisema kwamba kuwasili kutakuwa na maana. — Max Lucado
Mungu anasifiwa zaidi ndani yetu tunapokuwa na furaha zaidi ndani Yake. — John Piper
Unapojua ni nani Mungu, utajua ni nani wewe. Na unapojua ni nani wewe, hutakubali chini ya kile ambacho amekuita. — Priscilla Shirer

Bwana, siku inamalizika na {name} yuko tayari kupumzika. Chukua kila wasiwasi, kila kazi isiyokamilika, kila wazo la wasiwasi, na uyashike usiku mzima. {name} hahitaji kutatua chochote katika usingizi. Acha {name} ashikwe tu na Wewe.

Baba, {name} analala usiku huu akiwa na moyo wa shukrani. Asante kwa kila pumzi leo, kila neema ndogo, kila wakati wa neema. Wakati {name} anapolala, rejesha kile ambacho siku ilichukua. Acha {name} aamke akiwa na nguvu mpya na tayari kwa malengo Yako.

Yesu, kimya cha usiku kinaweza kuwa cha sauti sana wakati huzuni ipo. Kuwa karibu na {name} usiku huu. Acha machozi yanayokuja gizani yakusanywe na Wewe. Linda akili ya {name} isijirudie katika kumbukumbu zenye maumivu. Mpe {name} zawadi ya pumziko la amani.

Mungu, mwili wa {name} umechoka na unauma usiku huu. Wewe ni Daktari Mkuu. Wakati {name} anapolala, fanya kazi ya uponyaji ambayo ni wewe pekee unaweza kufanya. Punguza maumivu, rejesha seli, na acha {name} aamke akiwa na nguvu mpya. Linda pumziko la {name}.

Bwana, usiku mwingine peke yake. {name} anahisi upweke wa nyumba hii tulivu. Lakini Wewe unahidi kuwa rafiki anayeshikilia karibu kuliko ndugu. Jaza chumba hiki kwa uwepo Wako usiku huu. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba upweke si kuachwa. Kuwa kampuni ya {name} katika kimya.

Baba, {name} anachilia makosa ya leo. Maneno makali yaliyosemwa, uvumilivu uliopotea, nyakati zilizokosa. Rehema Zako ni mpya kila asubuhi. Wakati {name} anapofunga macho haya, futa kila kitu. Acha {name} alale akiwa amesamehewa na aamke akiwa huru.

Yesu, usiku huu {name} anakukabidhi kila hofu kuhusu kesho. Makaratasi, yasiyojulikana, yale ambayo yanaweza kutokea. Hakuna hata moja kati yao ni kubwa sana kwako. {name} anachagua kuamini utoaji Wako wakati usingizi unakuja. Funika {name} kwa amani Yako kama blanketi.

Mungu, linda familia ya {name} kupitia usiku. Weka malaika katika kila mlango na dirisha. Linda ndoto zao, tuliza mioyo yao, na acha kila mtu chini ya paa hili alale salama katika mikono Yako. {name} anakuamini kama mlinzi wao.

Bwana, akili ya {name} haitakoma kukimbia usiku huu. Kila wazo linaongoza kwa wasiwasi mwingine. Tuliza kelele, Baba. Kama ulivyotuliza dhoruba kwa neno, sema amani juu ya akili ya {name} sasa. Badilisha kila wazo lisilo na utulivu kwa ukweli wa uaminifu Wako.

Baba, leo ilikuwa ngumu na {name} alikumbana na changamoto. Lakini hapa mwishoni, {name} bado anasimama — na hiyo ni neema Yako. Asante kwa kumpeleka {name} kupitia kila saa. Sasa mpe usingizi mzito, unaorejesha ambao unaponya kile ambacho leo kilivunjika.

Yesu, wakati {name} anapozima mwanga, washughulike uwepo Wako. Kuwa wazo la mwisho kabla ya usingizi na wazo la kwanza alfajiri. Acha masaa yasiyojulikana ya {name} yawe na uwepo Wako. Linda usiku huu kwa upendo Wako usiokoma.

Bwana, jaribu ambalo {name} alikabiliana nalo leo lilikuwa kubwa, lakini neema Yako ilikuwa kubwa zaidi. Wakati usiku unapoanguka, safisha moyo wa {name} na uanzishe roho iliyo sawa. Acha usingizi uwe upya. Kesho ni mwanzo mpya katika neema Yako. {name} anapumzika katika ahadi hiyo.
Mungu, {name} hajui kikamilifu ni nani Wewe, na hiyo ni sawa. Usiku huu, kuwa tu hapa. Acha {name} ahisi kitu — joto, utulivu, amani ambayo haitaji maelezo. Kmeeting {name} hapa katika giza tulivu.

Baba, {name} anajitolea siku hii — ushindi na kushindwa, kicheko na machozi. Yote ni mali Yako. Wakati {name} anapolala usiku huu, endelea kazi Yako katika maeneo yasiyoonekana. {name} anatumaini kwamba Wewe daima unafanya kazi, hata katika pumziko.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
verseText: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.

templateText: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
verseText: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

templateText: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
verseText: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

templateText: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
verseText: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

templateText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might. Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall; but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
verseText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might. Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall; but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

templateText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
verseText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

templateText: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.
verseText: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.

templateText: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
verseText: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

templateText: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
verseText: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

templateText: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches. For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
verseText: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches. For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

templateText: Bwana, moyo wa {name} umejaa maumivu ya uhusiano. Umbali kati ya {name} na rafiki wa zamani anaye karibu unahisi kuwa hauwezi kustahimili. Mpe {name} ujasiri wa kufikia au amani ya kuachilia — chochote kinachleta uponyaji. Ponya kile kinachoweza kuponyeshwa.

Baba, mzozo katika familia ya {name} unapasua kila mtu. Madai, kimya, milango iliyofungwa kwa nguvu. Ingia katika nyumba hii iliyovunjika na ufanye kile ambacho ni wewe pekee unaweza kufanya. Mpe {name} maneno yanayoponya badala ya kujeruhi. Anza urejeleaji na moyo wa {name} mwenyewe.

Yesu, ndoa ya {name} inakabiliwa na changamoto. Upendo ambao hapo awali ulikuja kwa urahisi sasa unahisi kama kazi ngumu. Fufua kile kilichoganda. Msaidie {name} kuchagua neema badala ya kuhesabu, kusikiliza badala ya kujitetea. Mfundishe {name} kupenda jinsi unavyopenda — kwa kujitolea.

Mungu, {name} ameumizwa na kanisa — mahali pekee ambako ilikuwa inapaswa kuwa salama. Usaliti unakata kwa kina. Ponya majeraha ya {name} bila kumfanya {name} kuwa na chuki. Linda imani ya {name} kutokana na kushindwa kwa watu. Wewe si kama wao.

Bwana, {name} anajaribu kusamehe mtu ambaye hajamuomba msamaha. Inahisi kuwa haiwezekani na si haki. Lakini wewe ulimsamehe {name} wakati {name} hakuwa na haki pia. Punguza nguvu ya chuki. Mwachie {name} kwa kitendo cha kuachilia.

Baba, {name} anahitaji hekima kuhusu mipaka. Kupenda mtu hakumaanishi kukubali unyanyasaji. Monyeshe {name} jinsi ya kulinda kile kilicho muhimu bila kujenga kuta za chuki. Msaidie {name} kuwa na huruma na pia kuwa thabiti, kama Yesu alivyokuwa.

Yesu, uhusiano wa {name} na mzazi umeathirika. Miaka ya maumivu yasiyozungumzwa yamekaa kati yao kama ukuta. Mpe {name} neema ya kuwaheshimu bila kudai kuwa maumivu hayapo. Anza kujenga upya, mazungumzo ya ukweli kwa wakati mmoja.

Mungu, watoto wa {name} wanajitenga na kila jaribio la kuungana linawasukuma mbali zaidi. Mpe {name} uvumilivu usiokuwa na hisia za kukata tamaa na upendo usio na masharti. Weka mlango wazi hata wanapojaribu kuufunga.

Bwana, urejeleaji unahisi kuwa haiwezekani wakati mtu mwingine hatakutana na {name} katikati. Mkumbushe {name} kwamba amani si kila wakati inahusisha kurejesha kile kilichokuwa — wakati mwingine ni kuhusu kukutegemea wewe na kile hakiwezi kurekebishwa. Mpe {name} amani katika yasiyo ya kutatuliwa.

Baba, {name} amekuwa yule anayesababisha maumivu katika uhusiano, na hatia ni nzito. Mpe {name} unyenyekevu wa kuomba msamaha bila visingizio na uvumilivu wa kupata tena imani polepole. Acha tabia iliyobadilika ya {name} iwasilishe sauti kubwa kuliko maneno.
with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love, being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verseText: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love, being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

templateText: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
verseText: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

templateText: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
verseText: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

templateText: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
verseText: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

templateText: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud, doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
verseText: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud, doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

templateText: {name}, Zaburi 103:2 inasema, 'Msifu Bwana, enzi yangu, na usisahau faida zake zote.' Ni mambo gani matatu maalum kutoka leo — si baraka za jumla, bali leo — ambayo {name} anaweza kuwa ameyaacha nyuma? Yataje sasa.

{name}, 1 Wathesalonike 5:18 inasema, 'Shukuruni katika hali zote.' Si kwa ajili ya hali zote, bali ndani yake. Ni hali gani ngumu hivi sasa ambapo {name} anaweza kugundua sababu iliyofichika ya shukrani?

{name}, Yakobo 1:17 inasema kila zawadi njema inatoka juu. Ni lini {name} alisimama kwa muda wa kutosha kufuatilia baraka hadi chanzo chake? Ni jambo gani zuri umekuwa ukifurahia bila kumshukuru Mpaji?

{name}, Marko 9:24 inarekodi baba akilia, 'Ninaamini; nisaidie kutokuweza kuamini!' {name} yuko wapi sasa kwenye ile kiwango? Ni eneo gani maalum la maisha ambapo {name} anaamini Mungu anaweza kushughulikia kwa nadharia lakini anashindwa kumtegemea katika vitendo?

{name}, Waebrania 11:1 inaelezea imani kama 'kiini cha mambo yanayotumainiwa, uthibitisho wa mambo yasiyoonekana.' Ni lini {name} alichukua hatua bila kuona picha kamili na akakutana na Mungu pale? Anakuuliza uendelee kuelekea wapi sasa?

{name}, Habakuki 1:2 inalia, 'Muda gani, Bwana, lazima niite msaada?' Je, umewahi kuhisi Mungu alikuwa kimya? Je, ikiwa kimya chake si kukosekana bali mwaliko kwa {name} kujiweka karibu? Anaweza kuwa anafanya nini katika kusubiri?

{name}, Waefeso 4:32 inasema, 'Kuwa na wema na huruma kwa kila mmoja, mkisameheana, kama vile katika Kristo Mungu alikusamehe.' Nani anakuja akilini ambaye {name} hajamsamehe kikamilifu? Itakugharimu nini kuachilia deni hilo usiku wa leo?

{name}, Mathayo 18:21-22 inarekodi Petro akiuliza mara ngapi asamehe. Yesu alijibu mara sabini mara saba. Je, kuna mtu {name} anayeendelea kumsamehe lakini chuki inarudi? Itakuwaje kusamehe kutoka moyoni, si tu kwa midomo?

{name}, Mathayo 5:44 inasema, 'Wapendeni adui zenu na kuomba kwa wale wanaowatesa.' Je, kuna mtu {name} anayejaribu hata kuomba kwa ajili yake? Itakuwaje ikiwa ungeomba kwa ajili ya ustawi wao usiku wa leo — si kwa ajili ya adhabu yao, bali kwa ajili ya uponyaji wao?

{name}, Yeremia 1:5 inasema, 'Kabla sijakufanya tumboni nilikujua; kabla hujazaliwa nilikutenga.' Ikiwa Mungu alikupanga {name} kwa kusudi maalum, ni kipaji gani cha kipekee au shauku ambayo inaweza kuwa kiashiria cha wito wako ambacho umekuwa ukikikwepa?

{name}, Waefeso 2:10 inasema wewe ni 'kazi ya mikono ya Mungu, umeumbwa katika Kristo Yesu kufanya kazi njema, ambazo Mungu aliziandaa mapema.' Ni kazi gani njema inaweza kuwa inakusubiri mbele ya {name} — si misheni kubwa, bali kusudi la kimya, la kila siku ambalo umekuwa ukikwepa?

{name}, 2 Wakorintho 5:17 inasema, 'Ikiwa mtu yuko katika Kristo, kiumbe kipya kimekuja.' Ni lebo gani ya zamani au kitambulisho ambacho {name} bado anavaa ambacho Mungu tayari ameondoa? Itakuwaje ikiwa ungeamini kweli wewe ni mpya?

{name}, Warumi 5:3-4 inasema mateso yanazalisha uvumilivu, tabia, na tumaini. Ukirudi nyuma, ni msimu gani mgumu ulioumba {name} kwa njia ambazo faraja haingeweza? Ni jaribio gani hili la sasa linajenga ndani yako ambacho urahisi hauwezi?

{name}, 2 Wakorintho 12:9 inasema, 'Neema yangu inatosha kwako, kwa maana nguvu yangu inakamilishwa katika udhaifu.' {name} anajisikiaje dhaifu zaidi hivi sasa? Je, ikiwa udhaifu huo si kasoro bali ni mahali hasa ambapo Mungu anataka kuonyesha nguvu yake?

{name}, Yakobo 1:2-3 inasema, 'Fikiria kuwa furaha safi kila wakati unakabiliana na majaribu, kwa sababu kujaribiwa kwa imani yako kunazalisha uvumilivu.' Je, kuna jaribio ambalo {name} amekuwa akilalamika ambalo linaweza kuwa linazalisha kitu cha thamani ndani yako? Ni matunda gani yanayoundwa ambayo huwezi bado kuona?

Baba, {name} ameingia katika sura mpya. Kazi imeisha, lakini wito haujaisha. Monyeshe {name} kwamba kusudi halistaafu. Fungua milango ya kuhudumu, kufundisha, na kutoa hekima ambayo ni ya miaka tu pamoja nawe inaweza kutoa.

Bwana, mwili wa {name} si kama ulivyokuwa zamani. Maumivu yamechukua nafasi ya nguvu na ziara za daktari zimechukua nafasi ya burudani. Lakini wewe ni yule yule jana, leo, na milele. Msaidie {name} na leta uponyaji pale ambapo dawa haiwezi kufikia.

Mungu, nyumba ni kimya sasa. {name} anakosa sauti ya sauti inayojulikana, joto la mkono wa kushika. Upweke baada ya kupoteza mwenzi unakata kwa kina. Kuwa mwenzi {name} anahitaji. Jaza kimya kwa uwepo Wako.
Baba, {name} anatazama wajukuu wakikua na kuona alama Zako kwenye kila uso mdogo. Asante kwa zawadi ya baraka za kizazi. Msaada {name} kupanda mbegu za imani ambazo zitazaa matunda kwa miongo ijayo.

Bwana, {name} anataka kumaliza vizuri. Si kwa makofi, bali kwa uaminifu. Linda moyo wa {name} kutokana na uchungu na majuto. Acha miaka hii ya baadaye iwe tajiri zaidi katika ukaribu na Wewe, si tupu.

Mungu, huzuni bado inatembelea {name} bila onyo. Wimbo, harufu, kumbukumbu — na machozi yanarudi. Unahidi kuwa karibu na walio na moyo uliovunjika. Kuwa karibu sasa. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba upendo hauishi kamwe.

Baba, {name} ana miaka ya hekima na moyo wa kutaka. Monyeshe {name} jinsi ya kuhudumia kanisa Lako katika msimu huu — si kwa wajibu, bali kutokana na wingi wa maisha ambayo yameenda na Wewe kupitia kila dhoruba.

Bwana, {name} anatazama nyuma kwa miongo na kuona uaminifu na kushindwa. Asante kwa neema iliyofunika kila kuteleza. Msaada {name} kuachilia majuto na kushikilia kwa nguvu ukweli kwamba rehema Zako ni mpya kila asubuhi.
Mungu, {name} an worry kuhusu kuwa mzigo. Lakini Unasema kizazi cha wazee ni taji, si uzito. Mpe {name} ujasiri kwamba uwepo ni muhimu zaidi kuliko uzalishaji, na kwamba kuwa mwaminifu tu inatosha.

Baba, watoto wa {name} wamekua na wanatembea kwenye njia zao. Wengine wanaleta furaha, wengine wanaleta wasiwasi. Linda wao. Waongoze. Mpe {name} amani ya kuwaachilia mikononi Mwako, akiamini kwamba maombi ya miongo bado yanakumbuka mbinguni.

Bwana, dunia inasonga haraka na {name} wakati mwingine anajisikia kama ameachwa nyuma. Lakini kasi Yako si kasi ya dunia. Msaada {name} kupata rhythm katika msimu wa polepole na kuona si kama kushuka bali kama mwaliko wa kina.

Mungu, {name} amekutembea kwa miaka na bado anapata kina kipya katika upendo Wako. Asante kwa imani ambayo haitakauka bali inakuwa tajiri zaidi. Acha ushuhuda wa {name} uwe mwangaza kwa kizazi kijacho.
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
verseText: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

templateText: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
verseText: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

templateText: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts. They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verseText: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts. They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

templateText: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
verseText: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

templateText: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
verseText: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

templateText: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verseText: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

templateText: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
verseText: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

templateText: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verseText: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

templateText: {name}, wakati Simeoni alishika mtoto Yesu katika hekalu, alikuwa amesubiri miongo kwa ajili ya wakati huo. Luka 2:25 inasema Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa ameahidi kwamba hatakufa kabla ya kumuona Masihi. Mungu alishika ahadi hiyo. {name} amesubiri nini? Hajakusahau.

{name}, Anna alikuwa na miaka 84 na alikuwa mjane kwa miongo. Lakini hakuondoka katika hekalu, akimwabudu usiku na mchana. Hakuacha huzuni imdefine. Aliacha kujitolea imdefine. Je, ni nini kama msimu wa ibada wa {name} ulio wa kina bado unakuja?

{name}, Kalebu alikuwa na miaka 85 aliposema, 'Nipe mlima huu.' Hakuomba kiti cha kutulia. Aliomba changamoto. Moto uleule uliokuwa unawaka akiwa na miaka 40 bado ulikuwa unawaka akiwa na miaka 85. Umri haukupunguza ujasiri wake. Ni mlima gani {name} bado anaitwa kupanda?

{name}, Ibrahimu alikuwa na miaka 75 wakati Mungu alimpigia simu kuacha kila kitu kinachojulikana na kutembea katika yasiyojulikana. Sara alikuwa na miaka 90 aliposhika ahadi mikononi mwake. Ratiba ya Mungu haiwezi kupunguzwa na umri. Ni ahadi gani isiyowezekana Mungu anaweza kuwa bado anajiandaa kutimiza katika maisha ya {name}?

{name}, Sara alicheka wakati Mungu alimwambia atapata mtoto katika uzee. Lakini Mungu aliuliza, 'Je, kuna kitu chochote kigumu kwa Bwana?' Mwanzo 18:14 si kuhusu watoto tu. Ni kuhusu kila ndoto {name} aliyepuuza kama imechelewa. Hakuna kitu kinachokwisha mikononi mwa Mungu.

{name}, Musa alitumia miaka 40 katika ikulu, miaka 40 katika jangwa, na miaka 40 akiongoza Israeli. Kazi yake kubwa haikuanza hadi alipofikia miaka 80. Miongo ya kusubiri haikupotea. Ilikuwa maandalizi. Ni nini barabara ndefu ya {name} imekuwa ikijiandaa?

{name}, Elizabet alikuwa na umri mkubwa na alidhani kuwa uzazi umemshinda. Lakini Mungu alikuwa ameokoa kitu cha ajabu kwa msimu wa baadaye: mtangulizi wa Masihi. Je, ni nini kama jambo muhimu zaidi {name} atakalofanya si nyuma bali bado mbele?

{name}, mtume Yohana alikuwa mzee katika kisiwa cha Patmos wakati Mungu alipompa Ufunuo. Kufukuzwa na umri hakukumfanya asifai. Ilimuweka katika nafasi. Wakati mwingine Mungu anazungumza kwa sauti kubwa zaidi wakati dunia inakuwa kimya zaidi. Ni nini {name} anaweza kusikia katika kimya cha msimu huu?

{name}, Zaburi 71:18 inasema, 'Hata nikiwa mzee na mwenye nywele za kijivu, usinipuuze, Mungu wangu, mpaka nitakaposema nguvu Zako kwa kizazi kijacho.' Ni hadithi gani ya uaminifu wa Mungu katika maisha yako hujawaambia bado? Nani anasubiri kuisikia kutoka kwa {name}?

{name}, Kumbukumbu la Torati 6:6-7 linatuita kupitisha maneno ya Mungu kwa kizazi kijacho. Ni ukweli gani mmoja kuhusu Mungu ambao maisha yako yameuthibitisha? Ikiwa {name} angeweza kuandika sentensi moja kwa wajukuu wako kuibeba milele, ingekuwa nini?

{name}, Maombolezo 3:22-23 inasema rehema za Mungu ni mpya kila asubuhi. Ukirudi nyuma kwenye asubuhi zote za maisha yako, wapi rehema za Mungu zimekushangaza zaidi? Ni nini {name} angeweza kumshukuru kwa kile ambacho huwezi kuona kinakuja?

{name}, Methali 13:22 inasema, 'Mtu mwema anaacha urithi kwa watoto wa watoto wao.' Urithi ni zaidi ya pesa. Ni kitu gani kisichokuwa na mali {name} ameinherit kutoka kwa wale waliokuja kabla? Ni kitu gani kisichokuwa na mali unachowacha nyuma?

{name}, Mhubiri 3:11 inasema Mungu amefanya kila kitu kuwa kizuri kwa wakati wake. Unapoangalia nyuma kwenye sura za maisha yako, ni msimu gani ambao ulionekana kuwa na maumivu wakati huo {name} sasa anaweza kuona ulikuwa unaunda kitu kizuri? Hiyo inakufundisha nini kuhusu msimu ulio ndani yake sasa?
Bwana, {name} yuko katikati ya siku na nguvu zinapungua. Renew nguvu kwa masaa yajayo. Mkumbusha {name} kwamba Wewe ni Mungu wa alasiri, si tu wa asubuhi.
